filter-column-age-hint: Zoo kaadị ndị batara na ndepụta a ihe karịrị ụbọchị ole a gara aga. Ndepụta ndị ọzọ na kaadị ndị a na-amaghị ụbọchị ha batara ka ga-apụta. Idezi kaadị anaghị amaliteghachi ngụkọ oge ọ nọ na ndepụta.

advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Jiri @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt ma ọ bụ @listEnteredAt yọchaa ụbọchị kaadị. Dịka: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' ma ọ bụ @endAt = none. Tinye aha oghere ahaziri nke na-amalite na @ nʼime akara nkwuputa.
advanced-filter-description: Nzacha dị elu na-enye gị ohere ide ahịrịokwu nwere ndị ọrụ ndị a: == != <= >= && || ( ) A na-eji oghere kewaa ndị ọrụ. Ị nwere ike nzacha mpaghara omenala niile site n'ide aha ha na uru ha. Dịka ọmụmaatụ: Field1 == Value1. Rịba ama: Ọ bụrụ na mpaghara ma ọ bụ uru nwere oghere, tinye ha n'ime akara nhota otu. Dịka ọmụmaatụ: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Iji gafee mkpụrụedemede njikwa ndị a (' \\/), ị nwere ike iji \\. Dịka ọmụmaatụ: Field1 == I\'m. Ị nwekwara ike ijikọ ọtụtụ ọnọdụ. Dịka ọmụmaatụ: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. A na-akọwakarị ndị ọrụ niile site n'aka ekpe ruo n'aka nri. Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe usoro site n'itinye akara mgbachi. Dịka ọmụmaatụ: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ị nwekwara ike ịchọ mpaghara ederede site na regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Ọ na-adaba mgbe e mepụtara kaadị, ma ọ bụ mgbe agbanwere aha ya ma ọ bụ nkọwa ya, ma ederede ọhụrụ nwere nke a (a na-adịghị ewepụta mkpụrụedemede buru ibu ma ọ bụ nta).

impersonate-emergency: Ohere mberede: gwa ndị nchịkwa ndị ọzọ niile ugbu a
impersonate-emergency-note: Gịnị mere (a ga-ezigara ndị nchịkwa ndị ọzọ)
email-emergency-access-text:
__admin__ jiri ohere mberede banye dịka __user__ na __url__ na __time__.

Ihe kpatara ya: __note__

Ihe niile e mere n'oge ahụ dị na Ogwe nchịkwa / Ndị mmadụ / Ndekọ nyocha na Nsogbu / Akụkọ Nnọchi Anya.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Mado JSON mbupụ Kanboard: ihe nwere "columns" (ma ọ bụ tasks bu column_name) na uju "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns na-aghọ ndepụta, tasks na-aghọ kaadị.
import-board-instruction-deck: Mado JSON bọọdụ NextCloud Deck (bọọdụ nwere "stacks", stack ọ bụla bu "cards" ya). Stacks na-aghọ ndepụta, cards na-aghọ kaadị.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Mado JSON nchịkọta work-packages OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses na-aghọ ndepụta, work packages na-aghọ kaadị.
import-board-instruction-issues: Mado uju JSON okwu __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Okwu na-aghọ kaadị ekewara n'ime ndepụta Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Mado JSON mbupụ tasks Asana ({ "data": [...] } site na mbupụ Asana ma ọ bụ GET /tasks). A na-ekewa tasks n'ime akụkụ (memberships); tasks emechara na-aga na Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Mado JSON mbupụ ndepụta ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages na-aghọ ndepụta, items na-aghọ kaadị.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Pịnye ndepụta ọrụ markdown (ụkpụrụ ngwaọrụ markdown-kanban dịka Obsidian Kanban na-eji arụ ọrụ): isiokwu "## Aha ndepụta", nwere ihe "- [ ]"/"- [x]" n'okpuru ya. Isiokwu na-aghọ ndepụta, ihe ndị ọzọ na-aghọkwa kaadị; ndepụta ntụpọ dị mfe na-enweghị igbe nlele ka a na-ebubata, dị ka kaadị mepere emepe.
import-board-instruction-leo: Mado usoro Leo (faịlụ .leo). Ọnụ ndị dị nʼọkwa mbụ na-aghọ ndepụta, ụmụ ha na-aghọ kaadị nwere ọdịnaya ọnụ ahụ dị ka nkọwa, ọnụ ndị dị omimi na-aghọ ndepụta nlele. A na-ebubata ọnụ ndị akara dị ka ndị emechara.
import-board-instruction-opml: Tapawa ndepụta OPML, dịka Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq na ngwa ndepụta ndị ọzọ si ebupụ ya. Ihe dị n’ọkwa mbụ na-aghọ ndepụta, ihe dị n’okpuru ha na-aghọ kaadị nwere ndetu dịka nkọwa, ihe dị n’ọkwa dị omimi na-aghọ ndepụta nyocha. A na-ebubata ihe emechara dịka ihe emechara.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Tapawa faịlụ Org mode, dịka Emacs, Orgzly ma ọ bụ Beorg si ede ya. Isiokwu dị n’ọkwa mbụ na-aghọ ndepụta, isiokwu dị n’ọkwa nke abụọ na-aghọ kaadị. A na-edobe TODO na DONE, ihe ndị ka mkpa, mkpado, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE na CLOSED; igbe nrịbama na isiokwu dị n’ọkwa dị omimi na-aghọ ndepụta nyocha.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Tapawa faịlụ todo.txt: otu ọrụ n'ahịrị ọ bụla, dịka ngwa todo.txt na ngwa ndị dabara na ya si ede ya. Ọrụ ndị agwụchara ("x") na-aga na Done, +project na @context na-aghọ akara, (A) na-aghọ akara mkpa, due: na t: na-aghọ ụbọchị ikpeazụ na ụbọchị mmalite n'otu usoro ahụ.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Mado nsonaazụ task export: usoro JSON ma ọ bụ otu ọrụ n’ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọrụ ndị emechara na-aga na Done, project na priority na-aghọ aha, annotations na-aghọ nkọwa, depends na-aghọ ịdabere n’ọrụ ndị na-egbochi ha.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Wepụ faịlụ .boardarchive na mkpakọ ya ma mado ọdịnaya board.jsonl nke bọọdụ ahụ, yana ahịrị ụdị ya ma ọ bụ na-enweghị ya. Njirimara ikpokọta n’otu nke nlele bọọdụ na-aghọ ndepụta, njirimara nhọrọ ndị ọzọ na-aghọ aha, blọk ederede na igbe akara na-aghọ nkọwa na ndepụta ndetu, a na-echekwa okwu ndị mmadụ dere. A naghị ebubata onyonyo na faịlụ agbakwunyere.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Na Azure DevOps, mepee Boards, mgbe ahụ Queries, mee ajụjụ na-egosi kọlụm ndị ịchọrọ, wee họrọ Export to CSV; họrọ faịlụ .csv ahụ. Board Column (ma ọ bụ State) na-aghọ ndepụta, Board Lane na-aghọ ụzọ; ihe ọrụ na-aghọ kaadị ya na ụdị ha na tags ha dị ka aha, Assigned To, ụbọchị, nkọwa na nne na nna ha, kọlụm ndị ọzọ na-aghọ oghere ahaziri.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Na Microsoft Lists, mepee ndepụta ahụ, họrọ Export, mgbe ahụ Export to CSV, wee họrọ faịlụ .csv ahụ. Kọlụm Status (ma ọ bụ Progress) na-aghọ ndepụta, ihe ọ bụla na-aghọ kaadị, ya na aha ya, nkọwa, ndị mmadụ, ụbọchị na tags; kọlụm ndị ọzọ na-aghọ oghere ahaziri.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Na Microsoft Project, họrọ File, mgbe ahụ Save As, ya na ụdị XML Format (*.xml), wee họrọ faịlụ ahụ. Ọrụ nchịkọta na-aghọ ụzọ, ọrụ na-aghọ kaadị na Not started, In progress ma ọ bụ Completed, ya na ụbọchị ha, ndetu, akụrụngwa, sub ọrụ na ndị bu ha ụzọ.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Na Outlook, dọkpụrụ ozi gaa n'otu folda na kọmputa gị, ma ọ bụ chekwaa ha site na File, mgbe ahụ Save As, dị ka Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Họrọ otu faịlụ .msg, ma ọ bụ .zip nke faịlụ .msg na .eml. Mkparịta ụka ọ bụla na-aghọ kaadị na Board View / Email, ya na nzaghachi ya dị ka okwu na mgbakwụnye ya dị ka faịlụ.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Na MeisterTask, pịa aha ọrụ ahụ, họrọ Mbupụ ọrụ wee bupụ CSV, tinyezie ya ebe a. Nkebi na-aghọ ndepụta, ọrụ ndị a ga-eme na-aghọ kaadị, tinyere ndetu ha, ụbọchị njedebe, onye e kenyere na mkpado; ọrụ emechara na-edobe ụbọchị e mechara ha. CSV edere maka mbubata nke MeisterTask n’onwe ya na-arụkwa ọrụ.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Na Obsidian, mepee faịlụ bọọdụ Kanban dịka Markdown (ma ọ bụ mepee faịlụ .md n’ihe ndezi ederede), tinyezie ọdịnaya ya niile ebe a. Ahịrị na-aghọ ndepụta nwere oke kaadị ha, kaadị na-edobe mkpado, ụbọchị, mkpa, oghere na ndepụta nyocha ha, ebe nchekwa na-aghọkwa kaadị echekwara.
import-board-instruction-linear: Na Linear, bupụ nsogbu dịka CSV (Ntọala, Mbubata / Mbupụ, Bupụ data, ma ọ bụ mbupụ nlele), tinyezie CSV ebe a. Ọnọdụ na-aghọ ndepụta, otu na-aghọ ahịrị igwu mmiri, nsogbu na-aghọ kaadị nwere onye e kenyere, akara, ụbọchị, nsogbu nne na nna, mkpa, atụmatụ nha, ọrụ na okirikiri ha.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Na TickTick, mepee Ntọala, Akaụntụ, Ndabere & Mbubata wee mepụta ndabere, tinyezie faịlụ CSV ebe a. Ndepụta TickTick ọ bụla na-aghọ ahịrị igwu mmiri, kọlụm ya na-aghọkwa ndepụta; ọrụ na-edobe mkpado, ụbọchị, ndepụta nyocha, mkpa na obere ọrụ ha.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Na ClickUp, bupụ ọrụ dịka CSV (Ntọala, Mbubata / Mbupụ, Bupụ ihe, ma ọ bụ mbupụ nlele Ndepụta ma ọ bụ Tebụl nwere kọlụm niile), tinyezie CSV ebe a. Ọnọdụ na-aghọ ndepụta, ndepụta ClickUp na-aghọ ahịrị igwu mmiri, ọrụ na-aghọkwa kaadị nwere obere ọrụ, ndị e kenyere, mkpado, ụbọchị, mkpa na oge ha.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Na Nullboard, mepee bọọdụ, họrọ Bupụ bọọdụ a... na nhọrọ, mepee faịlụ .nbx n’ihe ndezi ederede ma tapawa ọdịnaya ya. Ndepụta na-anọgide dịka ndepụta, ndetu na-aghọkwa kaadị: ahịrị mbụ nke ndetu bụ aha kaadị, nke fọdụrụ bụ nkọwa ya. Ndetu raw na-enweta akara raw. Ọ bụrụ na faịlụ nwere ọtụtụ bọọdụ, a na-ebubata bọọdụ mbụ ya.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Na Kanri, mepee Mbubata & Mbupụ wee họrọ Bupụ otu bọọdụ (ma ọ bụ Bupụ data niile), tinyezie faịlụ .json ebe a. Kọlụm na-aghọ ndepụta, kaadị na-anọgide dịka kaadị, tinyere nkọwa, ụbọchị njedebe, mkpado na agba ha; ọrụ kaadị na-aghọ ndepụta nyocha. Site na mbupụ data niile, a na-ebubata bọọdụ mbụ.
import-board-instruction-planka: Pinye adreesị Planka gị (dịka ọmụmaatụ https://planka.example.com), aha njirimara na okwuntughe Planka gị, wee pịa Depụta. A na-eji ha naanị iweta bọọdụ ahụ, a naghị echekwa ha. Họrọ bọọdụ wee pịa Weta: WeKan na-agụ ya site na API Planka, ya na ndepụta ya, kaadị, nkọwa, oge ngwụcha, akara, ndị otu, ndepụta ọrụ na okwu, wee gaa n'ihu na mbubata dịka ọ na-adị. A na-ebubata kaadị dị n'ebe nchekwa Planka ka edebere; a naghị ebubata ihe mgbakwunye na kaadị dị n'ime ahịhịa.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Na Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), banye, kwenye na ikike Tasks.Read wee detuo token site na taabụ Access token. Mado ya ebe a wee pịa Depụta; a na-eji token ahụ naanị maka iweta a, a naghị echekwa ya. Họrọ ndepụta niile ma ọ bụ otu ndepụta wee pịa Weta. Ndepụta To Do ọ bụla na-aghọ ndepụta, ọrụ ọ bụla na-aghọ kaadị, ya na ndetu ya, oge ngwụcha na ụbọchị mmalite, nzọụkwụ dịka ndepụta ndetu, ụdị dịka akara, na mkpa dị elu na ọnọdụ dịka akara; a na-edebe ọrụ emechara. A naghị ebubata ihe ncheta na nkwughachi.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Na Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), banye, kwenye na ikike Notes.Read wee detuo token site na taabụ Access token. Mado ya ebe a wee pịa Depụta; a na-eji token ahụ naanị maka iweta a, a naghị echekwa ya. Họrọ akwụkwọ ndetu wee pịa Weta. Ngalaba na-aghọ ndepụta, peeji na-aghọ kaadị, ya na ederede ha, igbe ihe a ga-eme dị ka ndepụta ndetu na peeji nta dị ka sub ọrụ.
import-board-instruction-teams: Mado token nnweta Microsoft Graph nwere Chat.Read (site na Graph Explorer, akaụntụ ọrụ ma ọ bụ ụlọ akwụkwọ) wee pịa Depụta, mgbe ahụ họrọ nkata ma ọ bụ ọwa wee pịa Weta; a naghị echekwa token ahụ. Ma ọ bụ họrọ faịlụ: .tar nke mbupụ onwe gị site na teams.live.com/dataexport, ma ọ bụ .json nke ozi nkata. Nkata ọ bụla na-aghọ kaadị na Board View / Chat, ozi ya na-aghọ okwu.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Na Sandstorm, mepee grain __app__, họrọ Download backup n'ogwe dị n'elu grain ahụ, ma họrọ faịlụ .zip ahụ. Ihe dị n'ime grain ahụ ghọrọ bọọdụ, ihe ndị dị n'ime ya ghọkwara kaadị nwere ihe ngwa ahụ na-edebe banyere ha. Họrọ ngwa nke grain ahụ bụ nke ya: a na-ajụ grain nke ngwa ọzọ, ọ na-ekwukwa ngwa ọ bụ.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Na KanbanFlow, mepee menu bọọdụ ahụ, họrọ Settings → API & Webhooks wee detuo token API bọọdụ ahụ. Mado token ahụ ebe a, pịa Depụta, họrọ bọọdụ ahụ wee pịa Weta; a na-eji token ahụ naanị maka iweta ahụ, a naghị echekwa ya. Kọlụm na-aghọ ndepụta, ụzọ na-anọgide dịka ụzọ; ọrụ na-ejigide nkọwa ha, agba, akara, oge ngwụcha, obere ọrụ dịka ndepụta ndetu, oge e ji mee ya, atụmatụ, ndị mmadụ na okwu.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Pinye NJ akaụntụ Basecamp gị (nọmba dị mgbe basecamp.com/ n'adreesị ahụ) na token nnweta (site na ngwa OAuth 2 edebanyere na launchpad.37signals.com, ma ọ bụ nke njikọ dị adị nwere), pịa Depụta, họrọ ọrụ wee pịa Weta. A na-eji token ahụ naanị maka iweta ahụ, a naghị echekwa ya. Tebụl kaadị ọ bụla na-aghọ ụzọ nwere kọlụm ya dịka ndepụta, ndepụta ihe a ga-eme na-aghọ ụzọ Ihe a ga-eme; kaadị na ihe a ga-eme na-ejigide ederede ha, ụbọchị, ndị e kenyere na okwu, nzọụkwụ kaadị na-aghọ ndepụta ndetu, a na-edebe ihe a ga-eme emechara.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Nweta token nnweta site na OAuth 2.0 Playground: n'okpuru Tasks API v1 họrọ tasks.readonly, pịa Authorize APIs, wee Exchange authorization code for tokens, wee detuo token nnweta ahụ. Mado ya ebe a wee pịa Depụta, họrọ ndepụta ọrụ niile ma ọ bụ otu, wee Weta. A na-eji token ahụ naanị maka iweta a, a naghị echekwa ya. Ndepụta ọrụ na-aghọ ndepụta, ọrụ na-aghọ kaadị, ya na ndetu ha, njikọ na oge ngwụcha; obere ọrụ na-aghọ ndepụta ndetu, a na-ebubata ọrụ emechara ka edebere.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API Google Keep bụ naanị maka akaụntụ Google Workspace. Nweta token nnweta OAuth 2.0 nwere oke https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (na OAuth 2.0 Playground ma ọ bụrụ na onye nchịkwa Workspace gị kwere, ma ọ bụ site na akaụntụ ọrụ nwere nnyefe n'ofe ngalaba niile), mado ya, pịa Depụta wee Weta. A na-eji token ahụ naanị maka iweta a, a naghị echekwa ya. Ndetu ederede na-aghọ kaadị na ndepụta Ndetu, ndetu ndepụta ndetu na-aghọ kaadị na ndepụta Ndepụta ya na ihe ha dịka ndepụta ndetu. A naghị ebubata ndetu dị n'ime ahịhịa, ihe mgbakwunye na nkekọrịta.
api-import-desc: Weta ya site na ọrụ ahụ jiri akaụntụ nke gị. Ihe ị pinyere ebe a ka a na-eji naanị maka iweta a, a naghị echekwa ya.
api-import-fetched: E wetala ya. Lelee ndị otu dị n'okpuru wee bubata.
api-import-nothing: Enweghị ihe a ga-ebubata na akaụntụ a.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Na Pivotal Tracker, mepee taabụ MORE nke ọrụ ahụ wee họrọ Bupụ CSV (ma ọ bụ họrọ akụkọ wee họrọ Omume n’ìgwè, CSV), tinyezie CSV ebe a. Ọnọdụ akụkọ ọ bụla na-aghọ ndepụta, akụkọ na-aghọkwa kaadị nwere ụdị na akara ha, ndị nwe ha, onye rịọrọ, ụbọchị, nkọwa, ọrụ na ihe na-egbochi ha; atụmatụ nha na-aghọ akara akụkọ, ugboro ọrụ na-aghọkwa sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Na Tasks.org, mepee Ntọala, Ndabere wee họrọ Bupụ ọrụ, tinyezie ọdịnaya faịlụ .json ahụ ebe a. Ndepụta na-anọgide dịka ndepụta, ọrụ na-aghọkwa kaadị nwere ndetu, mkpado, ụbọchị, nkọwa na obere ọrụ ha; ọrụ emechara na-edobe ụbọchị e mechara ha, mkpa na-aghọkwa oghere ahaziri.
import-board-instruction-monday: Na monday.com, mepee nhọrọ bọọdụ, họrọ Omume ndị ọzọ na Bupụ bọọdụ na Excel (tinyere mmelite na obere ihe ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ), họrọzie faịlụ .xlsx ahụ. Kọlụm Status na-aghọ ndepụta, ìgwè na-aghọkwa ahịrị igwu mmiri; ndị mmadụ, ụbọchị, usoro oge na mkpado na-edobe ọnọdụ ha, kọlụm ndị ọzọ na-aghọ oghere ahaziri, mmelite na-aghọkwa nkọwa.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Na Super Productivity, mepee Ntọala, wee Mmekọrịta & Ndabere, họrọ Bupụ data ma tapawa ọdịnaya faịlụ sp-backup .json. Ọrụ ukwu ọ bụla na-aghọ ahịrị igwu mmiri, ọrụ ndị a ga-eme na-aghọkwa kaadị na Ime, Na-aga n’ihu, Ọrụ fọdụrụ ma ọ bụ Emechara, tinyere ndetu, mkpado, ụbọchị njedebe, oge ejiri na obere ọrụ ha; ọrụ echekwara na-aghọ kaadị echekwara.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Na Taiga, mepee Nchịkwa > Ọrụ > Mbupụ wee budata data ọrụ ahụ (buru ụzọ wepụ mkpakọ faịlụ .json.gz), tinyezie JSON ya ebe a. Ọnọdụ akụkọ onye ọrụ na-aghọ ndepụta, akụkọ ndị ahụ na-aghọ kaadị nwere ọrụ ha dịka obere ọrụ, epic na nsogbu na-enweta ahịrị igwu mmiri nke ha, sprint, mkpado, nkọwa na njirimara ahaziri na-esokwa. A naghị ebubata mgbakwunye.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Na Vikunja, mepee Ntọala, họrọ Mbupụ data wee budata faịlụ .zip ọ na-ezigara gị, họrọzie faịlụ ahụ, ma ọ bụ tapawa data.json dị n’ime ya. Nkewa Kanban na-aghọ ndepụta, ọrụ na-aghọkwa kaadị nwere akara, ndị e kenyere, ụbọchị, nkọwa, ndepụta ọrụ dịka ndepụta nyocha na ozi nkọwa; mkpa, pasent emechara na ọnọdụ emechara na-aghọ oghere ahaziri. A naghị ebubata mgbakwunye.
import-board-instruction-quire: Na Quire, mepee nhọrọ ọrụ wee họrọ Bupụ CSV, tinyezie CSV ebe a. Ọnọdụ na-aghọ ndepụta, ọrụ na-aghọkwa kaadị nwere obere ọrụ dịka kaadị ụmụ, ndị e kenyere, mkpado dịka akara, ụbọchị mmalite, njedebe na mmecha, nkọwa na mkpa dịka oghere ahaziri. Ozi nkọwa na mgbakwunye adịghị na CSV Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Na Wrike, bupụ ọrụ ukwu ma ọ bụ nchekwa na Excel, ma ọ bụ dejupụta ndebiri mbubata Excel nke Wrike, họrọzie faịlụ .xlsx ahụ. Ahịrị nchekwa na ọrụ ukwu na-aghọ ahịrị igwu mmiri, Status na-aghọ ndepụta, ọrụ ndị a ga-eme na-aghọkwa kaadị nwere Key, ọrụ nne na nna, ndị e kenyere, ụbọchị mmalite na njedebe, ihe ha dabere na ya na nkọwa; Priority, Duration na kọlụm ndị ọzọ na-aghọ oghere ahaziri.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Na Teamwork.com, dejupụta ndebiri mbubata ọrụ Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ma chekwaa ya dịka .xlsx, họrọzie faịlụ ahụ. Ndepụta ọrụ na-aghọ ndepụta, ọrụ na-aghọkwa kaadị; ọrụ malitere na -, # ma ọ bụ > na-aghọ obere ọrụ nke ọrụ dị n’elu ya (--, ## ma ọ bụ >> bụ otu ọkwa ọzọ n’okpuru). Ndị e kenyere, ụbọchị na mkpado na-edobe ọnọdụ ha; Priority, Estimated time na Complete na-aghọ oghere ahaziri.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Na Businessmap (nke a na-akpọbu Kanbanize), mepee Nchọgharị dị elu, họrọ Hazie nsonaazụ iji họrọ kọlụm, budata faịlụ Excel, họrọzie faịlụ .xlsx ahụ. A na-agụ kọlụm site n’aha Bekee ha (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ọ bụrụ na akaụntụ gị na-eji asụsụ ọzọ, buru ụzọ gbanwee aha dị n’ahịrị isiokwu ka ha bụrụ Bekee. Column na-aghọ ndepụta, Lane na-aghọkwa ahịrị igwu mmiri; ndị nwe, mkpado, agba, ụbọchị, nkọwa na njikọ nne na nna na-edobe ọnọdụ ha, Priority, Size, Type na kọlụm ndị ọzọ na-aghọkwa oghere ahaziri.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Na Redmine, mepee Nsogbu nke ọrụ ahụ, họrọ Dịkwa na: CSV n’okpuru ndepụta, họrọ kọlụm (Kọlụm niile, tinyere Nkọwa) wee bupụ, tinyezie CSV ebe a. Redmine na-akpọ kọlụm n’asụsụ gị, ya mere họrọ Bekee dịka asụsụ gị na Akaụntụ m tupu mbupụ. Ọnọdụ ọ bụla na-aghọ ndepụta, nsogbu na-aghọkwa kaadị nwere ụdị nsuso dịka akara, onye e kenyere, onye dere, ụbọchị, ọrụ nne na nna na nsogbu ndị metụtara ya; mkpa, ngalaba, ụdị a chọrọ, oge a tụrụ anya ya, % Done na oghere ahaziri na-aghọ oghere ahaziri.
import-board-instruction-notion: Na Notion, mepee nchekwa data dịka peeji zuru ezu, họrọ ••• na Mbupụ, họrọ Markdown & CSV, wee họrọ faịlụ .zip ọ budatara, ma ọ bụ otu CSV nchekwa data dị n’ime ya, ma ọ bụ tapawa CSV ahụ. Kọlụm aha ya bụ Status na-aghọ ndepụta (ọ bụrụ na ọ dịghị, a na-eji kọlụm mbụ yiri nhọrọ, akụkọ mbubata na-egosikwa nke ahụ); ahịrị na-aghọ kaadị nwere aha ha, mkpado dịka akara, ndị mmadụ dịka ndị otu, ụbọchị, na ederede peeji dịka nkọwa; kọlụm ndị ọzọ na-aghọ oghere ahaziri. A naghị ebubata mmekọrịta, onyonyo na mgbakwunye.
import-board-instruction-plane: Na Plane, mepee Ntọala ebe ọrụ, họrọ Mbupụ, bupụ ọrụ ukwu dịka JSON, CSV ma ọ bụ Excel wee budata faịlụ .zip, họrọzie faịlụ ahụ, ma ọ bụ otu faịlụ dị n’ime ya, ma ọ bụ tapawa JSON ma ọ bụ CSV. Ọnọdụ na-aghọ ndepụta, ọrụ ukwu na-aghọ ahịrị igwu mmiri, nsogbu na-aghọkwa kaadị nwere njirimara, nne na nna, ndị e kenyere, akara, ụbọchị, njikọ na nkọwa ha; mkpa, atụmatụ nha, okirikiri na modul na-aghọ oghere ahaziri. Mbupụ Plane enweghị nkọwa ọdịnaya ma ọ bụ mgbakwunye, ya mere a naghị ebubata ha.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Na Fizzy, mbupụ akaụntụ ahụ na "Account settings", ma ọ bụ kaadị nke gị site na "Download my data", ma họrọ faịlụ .zip Fizzy zitere gị, ma ọ bụ faịlụ .json nke otu kaadị. Bọọdụ na-aghọ ụzọ, kọlụm na-aghọ ndepụta, ya na "Maybe?", "Not now" na "Done" dịka na Fizzy; kaadị na-edobe nkọwa ha, aha ha, ndị ọrụ e kenyere, nzọụkwụ dịka ndepụta ndetu, okwu na faịlụ ha.
import-board-instruction-mail: Họrọ faịlụ .mbox, dịka Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt ma ọ bụ Gmail si echekwa ya site na Google Takeout, ma ọ bụ otu ozi .eml, ma ọ bụ tapawa ederede ya. Mkparịta ụka ọ bụla ga-aghọ otu kaadị n'ime ndepụta Inbox, ya na onye zitere ya, ndị natara ya na isiokwu ya, ka o wee pụta n'ọhụhụ Email; nzaghachi ga-aghọ okwu ya. Aha Gmail ga-aghọ aha. Anaghị ebubata ihe ndị e jikọtara.
import-board-instruction-ical: Họrọ faịlụ kalenda .ics, dịka Google Calendar, Apple Calendar ma ọ bụ Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud ma ọ bụ Outlook si mbupụ ya, ma ọ bụ tapawa ederede ya. Ọrụ na-aga To Do, In Progress, Done ma ọ bụ Cancelled dabere n'ọnọdụ ha, ihe omume na-agakwa Events, ya na ụbọchị mmalite na oge ngwụcha ha, ka ha wee pụta n'ọhụhụ Calendar na Gantt. Ụdị na mkpa ga-aghọ aha. A na-ebubata ihe na-emegharị otu ugboro.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Na takeout.google.com, họrọ Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar na Google Chat, mepụta mbupụ ahụ ma budata faịlụ .zip, wee họrọ ya ebe a. Ngwaahịa ọ bụla ga-aghọ ụzọ: ozi maka ọhụhụ Email, ndepụta ọrụ na ndetu ya na ndepụta ndetu ha, ihe omume kalenda na ọrụ nwere ụbọchị, na ebe nkata ndị ozi ha bụ okwu maka ọhụhụ Chat. Anaghị ebubata ngwaahịa ndị ọzọ na ihe ndị e jikọtara.
import-board-instruction-slack: Na Slack, mepee ntọala ebe ọrụ, họrọ Import/Export Data, mbupụ ebe ọrụ ahụ ma budata faịlụ .zip, wee họrọ ya ebe a. Ọwa ọ bụla ga-aghọ kaadị n'ime Channels, Groups ma ọ bụ Direct messages, ozi ya na nzaghachi eriri ya ga-aghọ okwu kaadị ahụ, dabere n'onye dere ha, ka ọhụhụ Chat wee gosi ọwa ahụ. Anaghị ebubata faịlụ.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Mbupụ site na mmctl export create, budata mbupụ ahụ ma họrọ faịlụ .jsonl ya, ma ọ bụ tapawa ederede ya. Ọwa ọ bụla na ozi ozugbo ga-aghọ kaadị, ozi o zipụrụ na nzaghachi ya ga-aghọ okwu kaadị ahụ, ka ọhụhụ Chat wee gosi ọwa ahụ. Otu ga-aghọ ụzọ. Anaghị ebubata faịlụ.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Na Telegram Desktop, mepee Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, họrọ usoro JSON ma mbupụ, wee họrọ faịlụ result.json, ma ọ bụ tapawa ederede ya. Nkata ọ bụla ga-aghọ kaadị n'ime Direct messages, Groups ma ọ bụ Channels, ozi ya ga-aghọ okwu kaadị ahụ, ka ọhụhụ Chat wee gosi nkata ahụ. Anaghị ebubata foto na faịlụ.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: Na WhatsApp, mepee nkata ahụ, họrọ Export chat na-enweghị mgbasa ozi, ma họrọ faịlụ .txt ebe a, ma ọ bụ tapawa ederede ya. Nkata ahụ ga-aghọ kaadị nke ozi ya bụ okwu ya, dabere n'onye zitere ha na oge, ka ọhụhụ Chat wee gosi ya. Anaghị ebubata mgbasa ozi na ozi sistemụ.
import-board-instruction-discord: Mbupụ ọwa Discord site na DiscordChatExporter n'usoro JSON ma họrọ faịlụ .json, ma ọ bụ tapawa ederede ya. Ọwa ahụ ga-aghọ kaadị n'ụdị ya, ozi ya ga-aghọ okwu kaadị ahụ, ka ọhụhụ Chat wee gosi ọwa ahụ. Sava ahụ ga-aghọ ụzọ. Anaghị ebubata ihe ndị e jikọtara.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Na Rocket.Chat, mbupụ data gị dịka JSON na "My Data" ma họrọ faịlụ .zip ọ zitere gị, ma ọ bụ faịlụ .json e bupụrụ nke otu ọnụ ụlọ. Ọnụ ụlọ ọ bụla na-aghọ kaadị, ozi ya na-aghọkwa okwu kaadị ahụ, ka ọhụhụ Chat wee gosi ọnụ ụlọ ahụ. A na-agụkwa .zip WeKan na-ebupụ maka onye mbubata CSV nke Rocket.Chat.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Na Evernote, mbupụ ndetu ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ ndetu dịka faịlụ .enex ma họrọ ya ebe a, ma ọ bụ tapawa ederede ya. Ndetu ọ bụla ga-aghọ kaadị nwere ederede ya, igbe ihe a ga-eme ya dịka ndepụta ndetu, mkpado ya dịka aha na ncheta ya dịka oge ngwụcha; ndetu ndị ncheta ha gwụrụ na-aga Done. Anaghị ebubata foto na faịlụ ndị e jikọtara.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Ọchụchọ nwere ike ịgụnye ndị na-arụ ọrụ iji mezie ọchụchọ ahụ.  A na-akọwapụta ndị na-arụ ọrụ site na ide aha onye ọrụ na uru nke eriri eriri kewapụrụ.  Dịka ọmụmaatụ, nkọwapụta onye ọrụ `list:Blocked` ga-amachi ọchụchọ ahụ na kaadị ndị dị n'ime ndepụta aha ya bụ * Gbochie*.  Ọ bụrụ na uru ahụ nwere oghere ma ọ bụ mkpụrụedemede pụrụ iche, a ga-etinyerịrị ya na akara ngụ (dịka `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - ​​kaadị dị na listi dabara nke akọwapụtara *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - ​​kaadị ndị dị n'ụgbọ mmiri dabara nke akọwapụtara *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - kaadị nwere akara dakọtara *<color>* ma ọ bụ *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: `__operator_user__:<username>` - ​​kaadị ebe *<username>* bụ * onye otu* ma ọ bụ * onye ọrụ *
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - ​​kaadị ebe *<username>* bụ onye kere kaadị ahụ
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - ​​kaadị ndị nke otu bọọdụ e kenyere nhazi *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - ​​kaadị nke otu bọọdụ ekenyere otu *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - ​​kaadị ndị ruru ụbọchị *<n>* ụbọchị site ugbu a.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ depụtara kaadị niile gafere ụbọchị ruru.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - ​​kaadị emepụtara *<n>* ụbọchị gara aga ma ọ bụ obere
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - ​​kaadị emeziri *<n>* ụbọchị gara aga ma ọ bụ obere
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - ​​ebe *<status>* bụ otu n'ime ihe ndị a:
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - ​​ebe *<field>* bụ otu n'ime `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` ma ọ bụ `__predicate_member__`.  Ịtụkwasị `-` n'ihu *<field>* na-achọ enweghị uru na mpaghara ahụ (dịka `has:-due` na-achọ kaadị na-enweghị ụbọchị ruru).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - ​​ebe *<sort-name>* bụ otu n'ime `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` ma ọ bụ `__predicate_modified__`.  Maka ụdị na-agbada, tinye `-` n'ihu ụdị aha ahụ.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - ​​ebe *<n>* bụ ọnụọgụ dị mma na-egosipụta ọnụọgụ kaadị a ga-egosipụta kwa ibe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Enwere ike ịkọwa ọtụtụ ndị ọrụ.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ndị na-arụ ọrụ yiri nke ahụ bụ *OR*ed ọnụ.  A ga-eweghachite kaadị ndị dabara na ọnọdụ ọ bụla.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` ga-eweghachi kaadị ndị dị na ndepụta ọ bụla aha ya bụ * akpọchiela * ma ọ bụ * Dị *.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Ndị ọrụ dị iche iche bụ * NA * ed ọnụ.  Naanị kaadị ndị dabara na ndị ọrụ niile dị iche ka a na-eweghachite.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` na-eweghachi naanị kaadị dị na listi * Dị* nwere akara * uhie*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Enwere ike ịkọwa ụbọchị dị ka ọnụọgụ dị mma ma ọ bụ adịghị mma ma ọ bụ iji `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` ma ọ bụ `__predicate_year__` maka oge dị ugbu a.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Na ndabara, anaghị achọ kaadị echekwara.

password-length-report-desc: Akaụntụ ndị banyere jiri okwuntughe dị mkpụmkpụ karịa ogologo kacha nta. Ọ bụ naanị ihe nchọgharị maara ogologo okwuntughe, ya mere ọ na-akọ maka nke dị mkpụmkpụ mgbe abanyere; okwuntughe na ogologo ya anaghị esi na ya apụ. Edoziri bụ mgbe a gbanwere okwuntughe akaụntụ ahụ - akaụntụ nke banyekwara ọzọ jiri okwuntughe dị mkpụmkpụ ka a ga-egosi ọzọ dị ka nke dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu.
password-length-filter-fixed: Edoziri ka ọ bụrụ okwuntughe toro ogologo nke ọma
password-min-length-description: A na-edepụta n'okpuru mbanye ejiri okwuntughe dị mkpụmkpụ. A naghị ajụ mbanye n'ihi ya.
password-min-length-enforce-description: A na-ajụ okwuntughe ọhụrụ dị mkpụmkpụ, na akaụntụ nke banyere jiri okwuntughe dị mkpụmkpụ ga-agbanwerịrị ya tupu ihe ọ bụla ọzọ. Ịgbanwe ya na-ewepụ oge nnọkọ niile nke akaụntụ ahụ. Okwuntughe LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS na Sandstorm bụ nke onye na-eweta ha, a naghịkwa enyocha ha.

database-migration-description: Bugharịa data dabeere na ederede (ihe niile ma e wezụga ihe ndị agbakwụnyere na avatar, ndị na-anọ na filesystem) n'etiti MongoDB na FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Database nke ọzọ ga-arụ ọrụ ma nweta ya (ọdụ ọnọdụ: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; gbanwee ya na WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Mgbe ọ gwụchara, tụọ MONGO_URL na database nke ọzọ ma malitegharịa WeKan (na Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb ma ọ bụ =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Bugharịa data ederede na FerretDB v1 (SQLite)

sandstorm-migration-description: Mgbe WeKan na-agba n'ime grain Sandstorm, a na-ebugharị database MongoDB 3 ochie ya na FerretDB v1 (SQLite) na mmalite mbụ, ma a na-ebugharị ihe ndị agbakwụnyere na avatar site na database gaa na ndekọ files/attachments na files/avatars grain. Nke a na-egosi ma mbugharị ahụ gara nke ọma na ka disk ole faịlụ database MongoDB raw ochie ka na-eji n'ime grain, ma na-enye gị ohere ihichapụ faịlụ raw ndị ahụ iji wepụta oghere.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Mgbe mbugharị gachara nke ọma, data na-ebi na FerretDB na filesystem, ya mere enwere ike ihichapụ faịlụ database MongoDB 3 raw ochie iji wepụta oghere disk grain. Enweghị ike ịgbanwe nke a.

features-desc: Njirimara nhọrọ nke WeKan a na-enye. A na-ezo njirimara a na-akaghị akara n'ihu ojiji onye ọ bụla. A na-echekwa data ya, ikike anaghịkwa agbanwe.

feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalenda na kalenda nke ọtụtụ bọọdụ.
feature-views-overview-desc: Ọnụọgụgụ, ịchịkọta dịka onye e kenyere ọrụ si dị, atụmatụ ụzọ, ihu njikwa na nnukwu bọọdụ.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Ndepụta ọrụ ngwaahịa, oge ọrụ dị mkpirikpi, akụkọ oge ọrụ na ọsọ.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Ọrụ fọdụrụ na nke emechara, nrugharị gbakọtara, oge okirikiri na oge nnyefe, ọnụọgụ ọrụ emechara, afọ ọrụ, ihe mgbochi, Monte Carlo na ihe ndị ọzọ e ji atụ nrugharị.
feature-views-map-desc: Kaadị dịka akara n'elu onyonyo ebugotere.
feature-approval-required: Debe njirimara mmelite WeKan tinyere n'ọnọdụ gbanyụrụ ruo mgbe onye nchịkwa ga-agbanye ha
feature-preview-admins: Ndị nchịkwa na-ahụ njirimara gbanyụrụ ka ha buru ụzọ nwalee ha
feature-pilot-users: Ndị ọrụ nnwale na-ahụkwa njirimara gbanyụrụ

feature-profiles-desc: Profaịlụ na-ezo njirimara a kara akara n'aka ndị ọrụ, otu na ụlọ ọrụ e kenyere ya. A na-agwa onye ọrụ profaịlụ ọ nwere. Onye na-enweghị profaịlụ anaghị emetụta, ọ dịghị data a na-ehichapụ, ọ dịghịkwa ikike na-agbanwe.

feature-profile-notice: Profaịlụ njirimara gị __name__ na-ezo njirimara __count__. Jụọ onye nchịkwa ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ otu n'ime ha.

card-field-visibility-desc: Oghere dị na Ntọala bọọdụ / Kaadị nke bọọdụ nwere ike igosi. A na-ezo oghere a na-akaghị akara na kaadị niile, obere kaadị na Ntọala bọọdụ / Kaadị nke bọọdụ niile. Data kaadị na ntọala bọọdụ anaghị agbanwe. Ịkanye akara ọzọ na-eme ka bọọdụ ọ bụla pụta dịka ntọala mbụ ya si dị. Bọọdụ ọ bụla nwere usoro oghere nke ya.

cards-loading-description: Otu bọọdụ ọ bụla si ebudata kaadị ya. Kaadị niile: a na-ebudata kaadị ọ bụla n'ime ihe nchọgharị (kacha mfe, atụmatụ niile na-arụ ọrụ, mana bọọdụ nwere ọtụtụ puku kaadị na-eziga nnukwu data na onye nlele ọ bụla). Umengwụ: ndepụta ọ bụla na-ebudata naanị kaadị a na-ahụ ugbu a (mkpuchi enweghị ngwụcha) na ọnụọgụ dị ndụ, ya mere bọọdụ buru ibu na-eji ntcheta na bandwidth pere mpe. E dobekwara site na WEKAN_CARDS_LOADING mgbanwe gburugburu.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Ntinye kaadị umengwụ bụ nnwale: ọnụọgụ kaadị na oke WIP ziri ezi, mana nlele Calendar/Table/Gantt na nhọrọ ọtụtụ na-egosi naanị kaadị ebudatara ruo ugbu a. Malitegharịa bọọdụ mepere mgbe ị gbanwesịrị nke a.
render-links-as-plain-text: Gosi njikọ dị ka ederede nkịtị
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, njikọ niile (ma njikọ markdown dị ka [label](url) ma tag HTML raw <a href>) ka a na-egosi mgbe niile dị ka ederede nkịtị, a na-apịaghị ya, n'ubi ederede ọ bụla (aha bọọdụ na kaadị, nkọwa, okwu, ndetu, wdg). Nke a na-egbochi njikọ na-eduhie eze. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ, ya mere njikọ na-anọgide na-apịa.
always-show-code-as-text: Gosi koodu niile mgbe niile dị ka ederede nkịtị
always-show-code-as-text-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, a naghị egosi ederede bara ụba dị ka markdown ma ọ bụ HTML: a na-egosi isi mmalite dum mgbe niile dị ka ederede nkịtị n'ubi ederede ọ bụla (aha bọọdụ na kaadị, nkọwa, okwu, ndetu, wdg). Nke a na-ekpughe ọdịnaya zoro ezo — okwu HTML (<!-- -->), ebe njikọ markdown, JavaScript na koodu ọ bụla ọzọ — ya mere a na-ahụ koodu niile mgbe niile, a naghị apịa ya, ọ naghị agba. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ, ya mere a na-egosi markdown nke ọma.
disable-all-import-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, a na-agbanyụ atụmatụ mbubata niile: ibubata bọọdụ site na WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo, yana ịmịpụ bọọdụ. A na-ezochi nhọrọ menu mbubata, nkesa na-ajụ arịrịọ mbubata ọ bụla. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ.
import-max-megabytes-description: Faịlụ kachasị ukwuu ibe Bubata na-anabata, na megabyte. Efu pụtara enweghị oke: faịlụ nwere ike buru ibu dịka ohere efu dị na diski ga-ekwe ka mbubata ahụ gwụchaa. A na-ede mbulite ọ bụla na diski nkesa ahụ otu akụkụ n'otu oge, a na-ajụkwa mbubata ga-ejupụta diski ahụ.
import-disk-full: Ohere efu dị na diski nkesa ezughị maka mbubata a.
import-upload-not-found: Faịlụ e bulitere adịghịzi ebe ahụ. Họrọ ya ọzọ.
disable-all-export-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, a na-agbanyụ atụmatụ mbupụ niile: ibupụ bọọdụ dị ka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, ma ọ bụ na NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, na mbupụ ihe agbakwụnyere otu. A na-ezochi nhọrọ menu mbupụ, nkesa na-ajụ arịrịọ mbupụ ọ bụla. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ.
disable-import-avatars-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, a naghị ebubata avatar (foto profaịlụ onye ọrụ) ma ọlị. Nke a na-ekpuchi mbubata WeKan JSON, mbubata Trello, na mmekọrịta avatar site n'ọ ndị nnye njirimara mpụga na mbanye (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). A ka na-ebubata aha na data ndị ọzọ; naanị avatar ka a na-agafe. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ.
disable-export-avatars-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, a naghị etinye avatar (foto profaịlụ onye ọrụ) mgbe a na-ebupụ bọọdụ (mbupụ WeKan JSON na CSV). A ka na-ebupụ aha njirimara na data ndị ọzọ; naanị avatar ka a na-ahapụ. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ.
anonymize-import-users-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, ibubata bọọdụ WeKan JSON na-eji aha nnọchi ọnụọgụ (user1, user2, ...) dochie aha njirimara, aha zuru ezu na akara mmalite onye ọ bụla ebubatara, na-ahapụ avatar ya, ma na-edegharị @username ndetu (na ubi requested-by / assigned-by) n'ime ọdịnaya kaadị na okwu ebubatara. Ọ dịghị ezi njirimara onye ọrụ si na bọọdụ isi mmalite echekwara. Okwu "user" na-eso asụsụ nke onye na-ebubata. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ.
anonymize-export-users-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, ibupụ bọọdụ na-eji aha nnọchi ọnụọgụ (user1, user2, ...) dochie aha njirimara, aha zuru ezu na akara mmalite onye ọ bụla ebupụrụ, na-ahapụ avatar ya, ma na-edegharị @username ndetu (na ubi requested-by / assigned-by) n'ime ọdịnaya kaadị na okwu. Faịlụ ebupụrụ enweghị ezi njirimara onye ọrụ. Okwu "user" na-eso asụsụ nke onye na-ebupụ. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Mgbe emenyere ya, ibupụ bọọdụ na-eji aha nnọchi ọnụọgụ (user1, user2, ...) dochie aha njirimara, aha zuru ezu na akara mmalite onye ọ bụla ebupụrụ, na-ahapụ avatar ya, ma na-edegharị @username ndetu (na ubi requested-by / assigned-by) n'ime ọdịnaya kaadị na okwu. Faịlụ ebupụrụ enweghị ezi njirimara onye ọrụ. Okwu "user" na-eso asụsụ nke onye na-ebupụ. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ.
disable-activities-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, a naghị edekọ ndetu ihe omume ma ọ naghị egosi ya ebe ọ bụla (akụkụ bọọdụ na taabụ ihe omume kaadị). Ọ dịghị akụkọ ihe onye ọ bụla mere echekwara. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ.
disable-notifications-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, WeKan anaghị eziga mkpọsa nlele (n'ime app, email ma ọ bụ ọrụ ndị ọzọ) maka ihe omume ọ bụla. A ka nwere ike idekọ ihe omume (ma ọ bụrụ na agbanyụghịkwa ya n'elu); naanị mkpọsa ka a na-egbochi. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ.
disable-watch-description: Mgbe emenyere ya, a na-agbanyụ atụmatụ nlele — ndị ọrụ enweghị ike ịdebanye aha na bọọdụ, ndepụta ma ọ bụ kaadị iji nweta mkpọsa, a na-ajụ mgbalị ọ bụla ịgbanwe ọkwa nlele. Ntọala bụ gbanyụọ.
backup-description: Chekwaa Ihe ndị agbakwụnyere, Avatars na/ma ọ bụ Data (nchịkọta niile dabeere na ederede na-abụghị ihe agbakwụnyere ma ọ bụ avatar). A na-eziga .zip ozugbo na nchekwa ahọpụtara — enweghị faịlụ nwa oge — dị ka backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, nwere YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars na /data. Nchekwa cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) na-eji njirimara ahaziri na taabụ nchekwa ha.
backup-scope-description: Sava dum, ma ọ bụ otu nzukọ. Ndabere nke nzukọ nwere bọọdụ ya na ihe niile dị na ha, tinyere ihe njikọ nke bọọdụ ndị ahụ — mana ọ nweghị akaụntụ ọrụ ọ bụla ma ọ nweghị ntọala sava, n’ihi na nzukọ niile na-ekekọrịta ha. Iweghachi ndabere nke nzukọ na-ede naanị na bọọdụ ndị nwe nzukọ ahụ.
theme-override-all-tenants: Ntọala nke metụtara ndị mgbazinye niile
continuous-backup-description: Na-eziga mgbanwe ọ bụla na nchekwa data, ihe ndị agbakwụnyere, onyonyo ndị ọrụ na ndekọ gaa na nchekwa faịlụ n'ime sekọnd ole na ole, ka e wee nwee ike iweghachi ọnọdụ oge ọ bụla. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'akụkụ ndabere a haziri oge ya, nke na-emepụta ebe nchekwa zuru ezu.
continuous-backup-enabled: Mee ka ndabere na-aga n'ihu rụọ ọrụ na sava a
continuous-backup-target: Nchekwa faịlụ e lekwasịrị anya (ụzọ zuru ezu na diski ọzọ, ebe netwọk a na-ekekọrịta ma ọ bụ ebe ejikọrọ site na rclone)
wekan-data-no-database: Ahụghị nchekwa data WeKan a pụrụ ịgụ.
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Ibe SQLite (ibe ndị gbanwere n'ime oge nke ọ bụla)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (mmemme ị nwere ike ịhọrọ ịwụnye)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Enweghị injin nchekwa data nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ na sava a
continuous-backup-encrypt: Zoo ndabere site na koodu nzuzo (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Faịlụ igodo koodu nzuzo (ụzọ zuru ezu n’èzí nchekwa faịlụ e lekwasịrị anya; mkpụrụedemede 64 nke usoro ọnụọgụ nwere ntọala 16 ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu nzuzo nwere opekata mpe mkpụrụedemede 16). Debe otu nnomi: na-enweghị faịlụ a, a gaghị eweghachi ndabere.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Ọ dịghị ebe (naanị nchekwa faịlụ e lekwasịrị anya)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Nchekwa faịlụ dị n’ime akpa nchekwa
continuous-backup-fetched: Ewetala faịlụ site na igwe ojii
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Faịlụ a pụrụ ịrụ nke Litestream (ụzọ zuru ezu)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faịlụ nchekwa data SQLite (a na-emepụta ya n'akụkụ ndabere, a naghị edegharị faịlụ a na-eji eme ihe ma ọlị)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Jiri nchekwa data SQLite e wughachiri mgbe usoro ga-amalite ọzọ (a ga-edebe nchekwa data ochie a na-edochi)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Weghachi ọgbọ ahọpụtara na ọnọdụ oge ahọpụtara? Ndabere na-aga n'ihu ga-akwụsị nwa oge mgbe iweghachi na-aga n'ihu.
backup-restore-select-first: Họrọ backup site na ndepụta mbụ.
backup-restore-confirm: Weghachi backup ahọpụtara? A na-ede ihe ndị agbakwụnyere/avatar na filesystem na data na database dịka ọnọdụ ahọpụtara.
gcs-key-filename-description: Nhọrọ: ụzọ na faịlụ igodo JSON akaụntụ ọrụ na nkesa.
gcs-credentials-description: Nhọrọ: mado igodo JSON akaụntụ ọrụ. Hapụ ya efu iji jiri faịlụ igodo ma ọ bụ njirimara ọnọdụ.
gcs-permissions-note: Nye akaụntụ ọrụ WeKan ohere ịgụ/ide na bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bucket gị → Permissions → Grant access. N'ime "New principals", mado email akaụntụ ọrụ — uru "client_email" site na igodo JSON gị — wee họrọ ọrụ "Storage Object Admin" ma Chekwaa.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Hapụ ya efu iji debe uru dị ugbu a.
azure-container-description: Container blob ebe a ga-echekwa faịlụ.
gcs-bucket-description: Aha bucket Cloud Storage ebe a ga-echekwa faịlụ.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: hapụ ya efu (na-eji endpoint mpaghara). Dabara S3: URL Endpoint site na MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces console gị.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bucket gị → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → aha bucket gị (ma ọ bụ Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → onye ọrụ gị → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → họrọ ihe eji eme ya 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. A na-egosi ya dị ka 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Otu ihuenyo dị ka Access key ID; a na-egosi 'Secret access key' naanị otu ugboro mgbe e kere igodo — detuo ya mgbe ahụ (ma ọ bụ Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaụntụ gị → aha egosiri n'elu (ọzọkwa n'okpuru Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaụntụ gị → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaụntụ gị → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaụntụ gị → Data storage → Containers → container gị (ma ọ bụ + Container iji kee otu).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → nhọrọ ọrụ n'elu → ID ọrụ gị (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → aha bucket gị (ma ọ bụ Create iji mee otu).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Ụzọ na nkesa WeKan ruo faịlụ igodo JSON akaụntụ ọrụ ebudatara (kere n'okpuru). Jiri nke a MA Ọ BỤ mado JSON n'ubi n'okpuru.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akaụntụ ọrụ gị → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (na-ebudata faịlụ). Mado ọdịnaya ya ebe a, ma ọ bụ chekwaa faịlụ ma debe ụzọ ya n'elu.
cloud-settings-desc: Site na WeKan dị na Weddy, Cloud Panel na-eje ozi ọtụtụ ngalaba WeKan site n'otu sava, nke ọ bụla nwere data nke ya. Na Ngalaba Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin na-ahazi ngalaba ndị ahụ na CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel bụ naanị maka SuperAdmin, na Ngalaba Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Site na igodo CloudFlare API, ngalaba nke mpaghara ya dị na akaụntụ CloudFlare gị na-enweta ndekọ DNS e ji proxy mee na asambodo CloudFlare Origin. Ngalaba ndị ọzọ na-enweta asambodo Let's Encrypt. A na-echekwa igodo ahụ na sava, a gaghị egosi ya ọzọ.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Ọ dịghị igodo CloudFlare API echekwara: ngalaba ọ bụla na-enweta asambodo Let's Encrypt.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Bugharịa ihe agbakwụnyere na Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Bugharịa ihe agbakwụnyere na Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Jiri MongoDB GridFS maka nchekwa faịlụ
migration-stop-confirm: Ị ji n'aka na ị chọrọ ịkwụsị ọpụpụ niile?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Iji hụ ihe ndị agbakwụnyere na avatar, bugharịa ha site na CollectionFS gaa na Nchekwa ọ bụla ọzọ.
s3-access-key-description: Igodo ohere AWS S3 maka nyocha
s3-bucket-description: Aha bọket S3 maka ịchekwa faịlụ
s3-enabled-description: Jiri AWS S3 ma ọ bụ MiniIO maka nchekwa faịlụ
s3-endpoint-description: URL njedebe S3 (dịka, s3.amazonaws.com ma ọ bụ minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: Igodo nzuzo AWS S3 maka nyocha
s3-settings-saved: A na-echekwa ntọala S3 nke ọma
writable-path-description: Ụzọ ndekọ ntọala maka nchekwa faịlụ
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Na-eme nyocha na ndozi zuru oke maka iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe data bọọdụ, gụnyere ịtụ ndepụta, ọkwa kaadị, na nhazi ụgbọ mmiri.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Na-ehichapụ ndepụta oyiri efu na-enweghị nsogbu. Naanị wepu ndepụta na-enweghị kaadị NA nwee ndepụta ọzọ nwere otu aha nwere kaadị.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Chọta ma weghachi kaadị na ndepụta nwere swimlaneId ma ọ bụ listId na-efu. Na-emepụta ụzọ igwu mmiri 'kaadị furu efu' iji mee ka a hụ ihe niile furu efu ọzọ.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Na-eweghachi ụgbọ mmiri, ndepụta na kaadị niile echekwara. Na-edozi swimlaneId ma ọ bụ listId ọ bụla na-efu na-akpaghị aka iji mee ka a hụ ihe.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Na-achọpụta ma rụkwaa ndepụta ndị na-efu ma ọ bụ mebiri emebi na nhazi bọọdụ.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Na-emelite URL avatar maka ndị otu bọọdụ iji jiri ezigbo nchekwa ndabere wee dozie ntụnyere avatar gbajiri agbaji.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Na-emelite URL mgbakwunye faịlụ niile dị na bọọdụ a iji jiri ezigbo nchekwa ndabere wee dozie ntụnyere faịlụ agbajiri.
migrations-admin-only: Naanị ndị nchịkwa bọọdụ nwere ike ịme njem
migrations-description: Gbaa nyocha na nrụzi data maka bọọdụ a. Enwere ike ịme njem ọ bụla n'otu n'otu.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Nke a ga-eme njem njem zuru oke iji lelee ma dozie iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe data bọọdụ. Nke a nwere ike iwe obere oge. Gaa n'ihu?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Nke a ga-ebu ụzọ tụgharịa ndepụta ọ bụla ekekọrịtara ka ọ bụrụ listi swimlane, wee hichapụ ndepụta efu nwere ndepụta oyiri nwere otu aha nwere kaadị. Naanị ndepụta efu na-abaghị uru ka a ga-ewepụ. Gaa n'ihu?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Nke a ga-emepụta ụgbọ mmiri 'Kfuru efu' wee weghachi kaadị na ndepụta niile nwere swimlaneId ma ọ bụ listId na-efu. Nke a na-emetụta naanị ihe anaghị echekwaba. Gaa n'ihu?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Nke a ga-eweghachi ụgbọ mmiri, ndepụta na kaadị niile echekwara, mee ka a hụ ha ọzọ. A ga-edozi ihe ọ bụla nwere NJ na-efu efu. Enweghị ike ịmegharị nke a ngwa ngwa. Gaa n'ihu?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Nke a ga-achọpụta ma mezie ndepụta ndị furu efu ma ọ bụ merụrụ ure na nhazi bọọdụ. Gaa n'ihu?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Nke a ga-emelite URL avatar maka ndị otu bọọdụ ka ha jiri ezigbo nchekwa azụ azụ. Gaa n'ihu?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Nke a ga-emelite URL mgbakwunye faịlụ niile dị na bọọdụ a iji jiri nkwado ndabere ziri ezi. Gaa n'ihu?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Enweghị ụgbọ mmiri, ndepụta ma ọ bụ kaadị furu efu iji weghachi
migration-progress-note: Biko chere ka anyị na-akwaga bọọdụ gị n'ụdị kachasị ọhụrụ.
step-ensure-per-swimlane-lists: Gbaa mbọ hụ na Ndepụta Per-Swimlane
step-ensure-lost-cards-swimlane: Gbaa mbọ hụ na ịkwọ ụgbọ mmiri furu efu
conversion-info-text: A na-eme mgbanwe a otu ugboro n'otu bọọdụ ma na-emezi arụmọrụ. Ị nwere ike ịga n'ihu na-eji bọọdụ ahụ nke ọma.
converting-board-description: Ịtụgharị nhazi ụlọ maka ịrụ ọrụ ka mma. Nke a nwere ike iwe obere oge.
migration-batch-size-description: Ọnụọgụ nke mgbakwunye iji hazie na batch ọ bụla (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Kwụsị ịkwaga mgbe ojiji CPU karịrị pasentị a (10-90)
migration-delay-ms-description: Ogbu oge n'etiti ogbe na millise seconds (100-10000)
migration-info-text: A na-eme mbugharị ọdụ data otu ugboro wee kwalite arụmọrụ sistemụ. Usoro a na-aga n'ihu n'azụ ọbụlagodi na imechi ihe nchọgharị gị.
migration-warning-text: Biko emechila ihe nchọgharị gị n'oge mbugharị. Usoro a ga-aga n'ihu na ndabere mana ọ nwere ike iwe ogologo oge iji wuchaa.
monitoring-refresh-failed: Ịmelite data nleba anya agaghị adị
search-boards-or-operations: Chọọ bọọdụ ma ọ bụ arụmọrụ...
account-locked: Akpọchiri akaụntụ nwa oge n'ihi ọtụtụ mbọ nbanye dara ada. Biko nwaa ọzọ ma emechaa.
invalid-credentials: Aha njirimara ma ọ bụ paswọọdụ ezighi ezi
username-too-short: Aha njirimara ga-abụrịrị opekata mpe mkpụrụedemede 3
account-created: Emepụtara akaụntụ! Ị nwere ike ịbanye ugbu a.

scrum-daily-observations: Ọrụ e zubere na ọrụ fọdụrụ kwa ụbọchị (ihe a hụrụ)

Ihe ndị a hụrụ anaghị edekọ mgbanwe niile ma ọ bụ gosi ngụkọta na njedebe ụbọchị. Atụmatụ a na-amaghị abụghị efu. Jiri omume mbupụ nke ngalaba a maka ihe a hụrụ kwa ụbọchị; omume mbupụ nke ogwe ngwaọrụ na-ebupụ nsonaazụ oge ọrụ dị mkpirikpi.

A na-achọta kaadị site na ID, ma ọ bụ site na nọmba kaadị na aha ya; kaadị ndị na-adabaghị ka a na-edepụta ma hapụ ha otu ha dị. Buru ụzọ lelee iji hụ ihe ga-agbanwe.

sync-recovery-description: Akụkọ mmekọrịta data echekwara nʼụbọchị 30 gara aga. Chọọ site na ID bọọdụ ma ọ bụ ndepụta. Nsonaazụ a na-emechabeghị nwere ike ka na-aga nʼihu ma ọ bụ kwụsịrị nʼetiti. Bugharịa ọzọ iji lelee ọzọ; akụkọ ndị a enweghị ike ịga nʼihu na ọrụ ma ọ bụ weghachite mgbanwe azụ.

sync-estimate-field: Oghere atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ọrụ Jira ejikọtara
sync-estimate-field-hint: Họrọ oghere ọnụọgụ nwere ID oghere Jira na otu a na-eji atụ atụmatụ, dịka mbubata Jira ejikọtara si mepụta ya. A na-enyocha mgbanwe dị na WeKan dịka esemokwu. A na-eleghara uru isi mmalite na-adịghị anya; null doro anya na-ehichapụ uru ejikọtara.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: A na-ede ibu ma ọ bụ atụmatụ oge GitLab n’oghere ọnụọgụ ị họrọ. A na-enyocha mgbanwe mpaghara dị ka esemokwu; okwu na-enweghị ibu na-ehichapụ ụkpụrụ ejikọtara.
email-recovery-description: Otu ahịrị maka onye nnata ọ bụla. Chọọ site na ID onye ọrụ. A na-ahapụ ọdịnaya ozi na oghere adreesị ozi eletrọnịkị onye nnata. Ịkwụsịtụ na-ejide ozi dị ugbu a na nke ga-abịa; Ịga nʼihu na-anwa iziga ozi nọ nʼahịrị nchere ugbu a. Nkagbu na-ewepụ ozi ndị batara nʼahịrị nchere ruo oge arịrịọ ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na iziga ozi na-aga nʼihu, nwaa ọzọ nʼoge na-adịghị anya. Enweghị ike ịkpọghachi ozi a na-ezigala, a pụkwara iziga ọzọ ozi a na-ejighị nʼaka na o ruru. Ọdịda na-adịgide adịgide na ndị ruru oke nnwale ka dị maka nyocha. Ịnwaleghachi ozi ndị dara na-amalite usoro nnwale ọhụrụ ma na-asọpụrụ nkwụsịtụ dị ugbu a.
email-recovery-saving: A na-emelite ahịrị nchere ozi eletrọnịkị…
email-recovery-oldest: Oge mbụ e tinyere nʼahịrị nchere
email-recovery-pending: Na-eche ma ọ bụ na-anwa ọzọ
email-recovery-empty: Enweghị ozi nọ nʼahịrị nchere ma ọ bụ ndị nnata akwụsịtụrụ.
email-recovery-unavailable: Enweghị ike ịgụ ahịrị nchere ozi eletrọnịkị. Lelee ikike onye nchịkwa na ịdị adị nkesa.
email-recovery-busy: Iziga ozi ma ọ bụ ọrụ ahịrị nchere ọzọ na-aga nʼihu. Bugharịa ọzọ ma nwaa ọzọ nʼoge na-adịghị anya.
email-recovery-failed: Enweghị ike ikwenye ọrụ ahụ. Bugharịa ahịrị nchere ọzọ ma nwaa otu omume ahụ ọzọ ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa.

email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Kagbuo ozi niile nọ ugbu a nʼahịrị nchere maka onye nnata a? A ga-ewepụ ọdịnaya ha, enweghịkwa ike iweghachite ha. A na-edobe ozi ọhụrụ emepụtara mgbe arịrịọ a gasịrị.
email-recovery-retry: Nwaa iziga ozi ndị dara ọzọ
email-failure-smtp-authentication: Nyocha njirimara ozi eletrọnịkị chọrọ nlebara anya
email-failure-smtp-configuration: Ntọala ozi eletrọnịkị chọrọ nlebara anya
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Onye nnata adịghị ma ọ bụ agbanyụrụ akaụntụ
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Enweghị ike ikwenye na ozi ruru; nyochaa tupu ịnwale ọzọ
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Enweghị ike ichekwa ihe nnata ozi
email-failure-delivery-failed: Iziga ozi ma ọ bụ nkwadebe dara
sync-time-estimate-hint: Atụmatụ oge na-eji oghere ọnụọgụ oge mbụ na oge fọdụrụ nke mbubata Jira mepụtara. Naanị otu oghere dabara ga-adịrịrị na bọọdụ a. A na-enyocha ndezi dị na WeKan dịka esemokwu; a na-eleghara uru isi mmalite na-adịghị anya, null doro anya na-ehichapụkwa uru ahụ.
sync-planning-fields: Oge ọrụ dị mkpirikpi na mwepụta
sync-planning-hint: A na-emekọrịta oge ọrụ dị mkpirikpi na mwepụta naanị mgbe Scrum gbanyere na bọọdụ a. Oge ọrụ dị mkpirikpi ma ọ bụ mwepụta na-adịghị ka a na-emepụta na bọọdụ a, ya na ụbọchị isi mmalite nyere; nke dị adị ka a na-ebu ụzọ achọta site na ID isi mmalite ya, mgbe ahụ site na aha. Mgbanwe atụmatụ mpaghara na-anọgide ruo mgbe isi mmalite gbanwere atụmatụ okwu ahụ, na Mmekọrịta mbụ anaghị ewepụ atụmatụ ọ bụla.
activity-recovery-description: A na-anwa iziga ọkwa a na-emechabeghị ọzọ na-akpaghị aka. Nyochaa ihe omume ndị na-adịghị ma ọ bụ ndị gbanwere tupu ịnwale ọzọ. Ịnwale ọzọ anaghị emepụtaghachi ihe omume.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Enweghị ike ibugharị ọkwa ihe omume na-eche.
activity-recovery-status-processing: Ndobe ikike iziga ozi na-arụ ọrụ
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Atụmatụ na ihe omume na-eche adabaghị
activity-recovery-busy: Onye ọrụ ọzọ na-elekọta ọkwa a. Bugharịa ọzọ ma nwaa ọzọ.
activity-recovery-denied: Ikike onye nnata ma ọ bụ nhọrọ ọkwa anaghịzi ekwe ka ezigara ya ozi.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Ihe omume mbụ adịghị ma ọ bụ ọ gbanweela. Emepụtaghị ihe ọ bụla ọzọ.
activity-recovery-failed: Enweghị ike imecha iziga ọkwa. E debere ọrụ na-eche.

activity-recovery-control-failed: Enweghị ike ikwenye ntọala iziga ozi. Bugharịa ọzọ ma nyochaa ọnọdụ ya ugbu a.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Kagbuo iziga ozi fọdụrụ maka ihe omume a ruo mgbe ebighị ebi? Enweghị ike ịga nʼihu na ya ọzọ. A naghị akpọghachi ozi eletrọnịkị nọlarị nʼahịrị nchere na ọkwa ezigalarị.
rule-email-recovery-description: Nyochaa nnwale ozi eletrọnịkị iwu edekọtara. Nnwale ndị a na-akwadobeghị nwere ike ka na-eziga ozi ma ọ bụ kwụsịrị nʼetiti. Jiri "Nyochaa" mepee otu iji zigaa ya ọzọ, kaa ya akara na ezigarala ma ọ bụ wepụ ya.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Enweghị nnwale ozi eletrọnịkị iwu dabara ọchụchọ a.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Enweghị ike ibugharị nnwale ozi eletrọnịkị iwu. Bugharịa ọzọ iji nwaa ọzọ.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan anaghị eziga ozi-e a na-ekwenyebeghị ọzọ n'onwe ya. Mgbe a na-eziga ya ọzọ, ọ na-aga naanị ndị nnata a na-ekwenyebeghị. Kaa ya akara na ezigarala ya ma ọ bụrụ na ị maara na ọ ruru, ma ọ bụ wepụ ya.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Izipu nke mbụ nwere ike ka na-aga n'ihu. Ị nwere ike ikpebi mgbe __time__ gasịrị.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Zigara ndị nnata a na-ekwenyebeghị ọzọ
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Ị chọrọ izigara ndị nnata a na-ekwenyebeghị ozi-e a ọzọ? Onye ọ bụla sava ozi-e ya nabatara ya n'agwaghị WeKan ga-enweta ya ugboro abụọ.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Ị chọrọ ịka ozi-e a akara na ezigarala ya mmadụ niile? Mee nke a naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ị maara na ọ ruru.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Ị chọrọ iwepụ ozi-e a? Agaghị ezigara ya ndị nnata a na-ekwenyebeghị.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Izipu nke mbụ nwere ike ka na-aga n'ihu. Nwaa ọzọ ma emechaa.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: E kpebiela ihe a ga-eme na ozi-e a.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Izipu ọzọ nke gara aga nwere ike ka na-aga n'ihu. Nwaa ọzọ ma emechaa.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Ekwenyelarị onye nnata ọ bụla. Kama izipu ọzọ, kaa ya akara na ezigarala ya.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Sava ozi-e azaghị. Ozi-e e zigara ọzọ nwere ike iru ma ọ bụ ghara iru; a na-egosi na izipu ya ka na-aga n'ihu.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Onye nchịkwa ọzọ na-ekpebi ihe a ga-eme na ozi-e a. Nwaa ọzọ n'oge na-adịghị anya.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Ozi-e echekwara adabaghịkwa na mbọ a, ya mere a pụghị ikpebi ihe a ga-eme na ya ebe a.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Ndekọ echekwara maka mbọ a ezighi ezi, ya mere a pụghị ikpebi ihe a ga-eme na ya ebe a.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Enweghị ike ikpebi ihe a ga-eme na ozi-e a. Bugharịa ibe ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.
rule-email-legacy-description: Ụdị WeKan ochie kwadebere ozi-e iwu ndị a n'edekọghị ebe ihe dị n'ime ha si bịa, ya mere WeKan agaghị eziga ha n'onwe ya. Mgbe ị nyochachara na onye dere iwu ahụ ka nwere ikike ịbanye, jikọta ozi-e ọzọ ka a kwadebe ya site n'ọnọdụ kaadị ahụ ugbu a, ma ọ bụ tụfuo ya.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Ị chọrọ ịkwadebe ozi-e a ọzọ site n'ọnọdụ kaadị ahụ ugbu a? Ihe dị n'ime ya nwere ike ịdị iche na nke a kwadebere na mbụ.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Ị chọrọ ịtụfu ozi-e a? Agaghị eziga ya ma ọlị.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Enweghị ike ibunye ozi-e iwu ndị na-eche nyocha. Bugharịa ibe ahụ ka ị nwaa ọzọ.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Onye dere iwu ahụ enweghịzi ikike ịbanye na kaadị a, ma ọ bụ iwu ahụ agbanweela, ya mere a pụghị ijikọ ozi-e ahụ ọzọ. Ị nwere ike ịtụfu ya.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Ihe omume kpalitere ozi-e a agbanweela, ya mere a pụghị ijikọ ya ọzọ. Ị nwere ike ịtụfu ya.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Kaadị ozi-e a si bịa adịghịzi, ya mere a pụghị ijikọ ya ọzọ. Ị nwere ike ịtụfu ya.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: A naghịzi echekwa ndekọ mmezu iwu kwadebere ozi-e a, ya mere a pụghị ijikọ ya ọzọ. Ị nwere ike ịtụfu ya.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Ezigarala ozi-e a, a nwalarị iziga ya ma ọ bụ a tụfuola ya.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Enweghị ike imecha ihe omume a. Bugharịa ibe ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Omume mmekọrịta ndepụta a na-enweghị ike ịmegharị
stuck-sync-operation-description: Omume mmekọrịta ndepụta ọ bụla echekwara ebe a kwụsịrị n’etiti, a pụghịzi imecha ya, n’ihi na ewepụrụ ndepụta ya, megharịrị ya ma ọ bụ gbanwee ntọala ya, ma ọ bụ onye malitere ya enweghịzi ikike ide ihe. Mgbe otu ka na-echere, ndepụta ahụ enweghị ike imekọrịta. Tụfuo ya ka ndepụta ahụ nwee ike imekọrịta ọzọ: mgbanwe e tinyelarị na-anọgide, a gaghị ede mgbanwe ndị fọdụrụ echekwara, mmekọrịta na-esote ga-atụnyere ndepụta ahụ na isi iyi ya ọzọ.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Ewepụrụ ndepụta ahụ, megharịrị ya ma ọ bụ gbanwee ntọala mmekọrịta ya
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Onye ọrụ malitere ya enweghịzi ikike ide ihe na ndepụta ahụ dum
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Ụdị WeKan ochie chekwara ya na-enweghị ihe kpalitere ya
stuck-sync-operation-reason-unknown: Enweghị ike ịlele ya ugbu a
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Enwere ike ịmegharị ya ugbu a, ọ ga-emecha n’onwe ya, ya mere enweghị ike ịtụfu ya.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Tụfuo omume mmekọrịta ndepụta a echekwara? Mgbanwe ọ tinyelarị na-anọgide; a gaghị ede ndị fọdụrụ. Ndepụta ahụ ga-enwe ike imekọrịta ọzọ.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Enweghị omume mmekọrịta ndepụta na-echere nyocha.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: A na-egosi naanị 50 kacha ochie. Tụfuo ụfọdụ ma mee ka ibe a dị ọhụrụ ka ị hụ ndị ọzọ.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Enweghị ike ibunye omume mmekọrịta ndepụta. Mee ka ibe a dị ọhụrụ ka ị nwaa ọzọ.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Achọpụtaghị na omume a rapaara, ya mere enweghị ike ịtụfu ya.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Enwere ike ịmegharị omume a ugbu a, ọ ga-emecha n’onwe ya, ya mere a tụfughị ya.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Ndepụta a na-emekọrịta ugbu a. Nwaa ọzọ n’oge na-adịghị anya.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Enweghị ike imecha ihe omume a. Bugharịa ibe ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.
interrupted-import-heading: Mbubata bọọdụ kwụsịrị tupu ha agwụ
interrupted-import-description: Mbubata bọọdụ ọ bụla ebe a kwụsịrị n’etiti — sava malitegharịrị, ma ọ bụ mbubata kụrụ afọ n’ala — wee hapụ bọọdụ ezughị ezu. Enweghị ike ịga n’ihu na mbubata, n’ihi na a naghị edobe faịlụ isi iyi ya. Debe bọọdụ ahụ dịka ọ dị, ma ọ bụ tụfuo ya ma bubata faịlụ ahụ ọzọ. Ịtụfu ya na-ewepụ bọọdụ mbubata a mepụtara na ihe niile dị na ya, tinyere ihe ọ bụla agbakwunyere na ya kemgbe ahụ.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: A na-atụfu ya; tụfuo ya ọzọ iji mechaa
interrupted-import-scrum: Ọkwa Scrum ya nwere ebe nchekwa ọganihu nke ya (__state__, __next__ n’ime usoro __total__). Ọ bụrụ na ị debe bọọdụ ahụ, mechaa ma ọ bụ tụfuo ya site na mgbake mbubata Scrum nke bọọdụ ahụ.
interrupted-import-counts: Ahịrị igwu mmiri __swimlanes__, ndepụta __lists__, kaadị __cards__, ndepụta nyocha __checklists__, ozi nkọwa __comments__, mgbakwunye __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Debe bọọdụ a ezughị ezu dịka ọ dị? A naghị ewepụ ihe ọ bụla, a naghịzi edepụta mbubata ahụ ebe a.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Tụfuo mbubata a? A ga-ewepụ bọọdụ ọ mepụtara na ihe niile dị na ya kpamkpam ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.
interrupted-import-empty: Enweghị mbubata bọọdụ kwụsịrị na-echere nyocha.

interrupted-import-unavailable: Enweghị ike ibunye mbubata bọọdụ kwụsịrị. Mee ka ibe a dị ọhụrụ ka ị nwaa ọzọ.

interrupted-import-failed: Enweghị ike imecha ihe omume a. Bugharịa ibe ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.
saml-login-not-started: Amaliteghị nbanye SAML a na taabụ ihe nchọgharị a. Biko banye ọzọ.
history-request-pending-undo: Nkesa akwadobeghị mweghachi azụ ikpeazụ gị.
history-request-pending-redo: Nkesa akwadobeghị mmegharị ọzọ ikpeazụ gị.
history-request-hint: Ịnwale ọzọ na-emeghachi otu arịrịọ ahụ, ya mere ọ nweghị ike iweghachite mgbanwe nke abụọ azụ.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Mwegharị, mmeghachi ma ọ bụ mweghachi nke mgbanwe Scrum kwụsịrị nʼihi esemokwu. Egbochiri mgbanwe Scrum na bọọdụ a ruo mgbe a dozịrị ya.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: E dere __applied__ nʼime mgbanwe __total__, edeghị __pending__, ma onye ọzọ gbanwere __conflicted__ kemgbe ahụ.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Ịlaghachi azụ na-eweghachi ndekọ ọ bụla gbanwere otu o dị na mbụ; a na-enye ya naanị mgbe ọ dịghị onye ọzọ gbanwere ndekọ ndị ahụ kemgbe ahụ. Ịhapụ bọọdụ otu o dị na-ewepụ ọrụ kwụsịrị ma ọ naghị agbanwe ndekọ ọ bụla. Nʼụzọ ọ bụla, a na-edekọ ya na Ogwe nchịkwa, Nsogbu, Mgbake.

inbound-account-invalid: Igbe ozi IMAP chọrọ aha sava ziri ezi.
feature-views-email-desc: Bọọdụ dị ka igbe ozi: ndepụta ozi-e bụ Igbe nnabata, ndepụta ndị ọzọ bụ nchekwa, aha bụ aha, ndị otu na-ede ma na-aza ozi-e site na adreesị bọọdụ.
email-view-not-receiving: Bọọdụ a anaghị anata ozi-e ugbu a. Gbanye ya na Ntọala ọkwa nke bọọdụ → Ozi-e gaa na kaadị.
email-view-invalid-address: Otu n'ime adreesị ndị ahụ abụghị adreesị ozi-e ziri ezi.
email-view-no-recipient: Tinye opekata mpe otu onye nnata.
email-view-too-many-recipients: Ihe kacha ọtụtụ bụ ndị nnata 20 n'otu ozi.
email-view-too-many: Ezigara ozi-e karịrị akarị n'ime elekere gara aga. Nwaa ọzọ ma emechaa.
email-view-no-list: Bọọdụ chọrọ ndepụta maka ozi-e ahụ.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bọọdụ dị ka ebe mkparịta ụka: ebe ọrụ, bọọdụ, ụzọ, ndepụta na kaadị dị ka osisi nke ọwa, kaadị n'etiti na okwu ya dị ka ozi mkparịta ụka.
chat-view-pick-card: Họrọ kaadị site na ọwa ka ịhụ ya ebe a.
chat-view-no-messages: Enweghị ozi ka ugbu a. Dee nke mbụ.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Otu kaadị ahụ n'ọtụtụ otu kọlụm nwere aha - site na mmecha, mkpa, ihe ịrịba ama ma ọ bụ ihe ọ bụla ọzọ - a na-ebugharị n'etiti kọlụm site n'ịdọkpụ.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu bọọdụ → Iwu na-atụ aro iwu site n'ihe ndị mmadụ na-eji aka eme ugboro ugboro.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu bọọdụ → Nchịkọta na-egosi ihe onye ọ bụla mere na bọọdụ n'ụbọchị ma ọ bụ izu ikpeazụ, na ihe gafere oge.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu bọọdụ → Kemgbe nleta ikpeazụ gị na-egosi ihe ndị ọzọ gbanwere na bọọdụ.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Ọchụchọ zuru ezu na-aghọta nkebi ahịrịokwu dị ka "kaadị m gafere oge".
column-sets-empty: Enweghị otu kọlụm ọ bụla ugbu a. Onye nlekọta bọọdụ nwere ike ịme otu: nye ya aha, wee tinye kọlụm ya.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bọọdụ dị ka ihe nsochi okwu GitHub ma ọ bụ Gitea: kaadị dị ka okwu, akara na ihe ngosi ọganihu, nkọwa dị ka mkparịta ụka, mgbakwunye dị ka faịlụ, na akụkọ ihe mere bọọdụ nwere nweghachi.
vcs-no-issues: Ọ dịghị okwu dabara na ọchụchọ a.
vcs-no-milestones: Enweghị ihe ngosi ọganihu ugbu a. Akara nwere ụbọchị njedebe bụ ihe ngosi ọganihu.
vcs-no-list: Bọọdụ a enweghị ndepụta ma ọ bụ ụzọ maka okwu a.
card-qr-code-desc: Nyochaa ya iji mepee kaadị a na ekwentị ma ọ bụ tablet.
card-qr-code-too-long: Njikọ kaadị a ogologo nke ukwuu maka koodu QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Enwebeghị wiki ọ bụla. Mbubata nzukọ GitHub na-ebute wiki nke ebe nchekwa ebe a.
github-org-import-desc: Ebe nchekwa ọ bụla nke nzukọ ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ na-aghọ bọọdụ nke ya, nke a na-emeghe na Board View / Version Control: okwu ya na nkọwa ha, aha ha na faịlụ ha, mwepụta ya, usoro ọrụ GitHub Actions ya dịka Iwu, na wiki ya.
github-org-import-owner: Nzukọ ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ
github-org-import-token-hint: Achọrọ ya maka ebe nchekwa nzuzo na oke API dị elu. A na-eji ya naanị mgbe mbubata na-aga ma a dịghị echekwa ya mgbe ọ bụla.
github-org-import-issues: Okwu, ya na nkọwa, aha na faịlụ
github-org-import-actions: Usoro ọrụ GitHub Actions dịka Iwu
github-org-import-wiki: Wiki, ya na akụkọ ihe mere ya
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Dee aha nzukọ ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ, ma ọ bụ adreesị GitHub ya.
github-org-import-running: Mbubata nzukọ na-aga n'ihu ugbu a.
optional-apis-desc: REST API ndị nwere ụdị API nke ndị nsochi ndị ọzọ, ka ngwa na script ha nwee ike iji WeKan a dịka azụ ha: ihe ha chekwara na-adị na WeKan, na bọọdụ WeKan. Nke ọ bụla gbanyụrụ ruo mgbe a kara ya akara ebe a. Ọ dịghị nke nwere ikike nke ya: onye ahịa na-abanye site na token API WeKan ma nwee ike ịhụ ma gbanwee naanị ihe onye ahụ nwere ike ịhụ ma gbanwee na WeKan. Ha niile chọrọ ka WeKan REST API gbanye (WITH_API=true). Adreesị dị n'okpuru nke ọ bụla bụ nke onye ahịa na-eji dịka sava ya.
optional-api-trello-desc: Ngwa na script e dere maka REST API nke Trello (dịka ọmụmaatụ Trellinator) na-arụ ọrụ na WeKan: bọọdụ, ndepụta, kaadị, aha, ndị otu, okwu na ndepụta ndetu. Token Trello bụ token API WeKan. Ihichapụ kaadị na-ebuga ya na ebe nchekwa na WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Ndị ahịa nke REST API v2 nke Jira na-arụ ọrụ na WeKan: ọrụ bụ bọọdụ (igodo ya bụ igodo bọọdụ), okwu bụ kaadị (DEV-7), ọnọdụ bụ ndepụta, mgbanwe na-ebugharị kaadị ahụ. Nchọta na-anabata JQL dị mfe: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text na ORDER BY. Banye site na token API WeKan dịka okwuntughe. Ihichapụ okwu na-ebuga ya na ebe nchekwa.
optional-api-github-desc: Ndị ahịa nke REST API nke GitHub maka okwu na-arụ ọrụ na WeKan: ebe nchekwa koodu bụ bọọdụ, okwu bụ kaadị, ya na aha, ihe ngosi ọganihu (aha nwere ụbọchị njedebe), okwu nkọwa, na mepere emepe ma ọ bụ emechiri emechi dịka na Nlele bọọdụ / Njikwa ụdị. Token bụ token API WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Ndị ahịa nke REST API nke Gitea na Forgejo maka okwu na-arụ ọrụ na WeKan otu ụzọ ahụ dịka API dabara na GitHub: ebe nchekwa koodu bụ bọọdụ, okwu bụ kaadị. Token bụ token API WeKan.
bots-none: Enweghị bọọtụ ọ bụla ugbu a. Bọọtụ bụ onye na-agba ọsọ na sava nke gị - onye nnọchite AI, ọrụ CI, edemede - nke bọọdụ a na-enyefe kaadị.
bots-no-runs: Ọ dịghị bọọtụ na-arụ ọrụ ugbu a.
bot-not-found: Bọọtụ ahụ anọghị na bọọdụ a.
bot-option-not-found: Azịza ahụ abụghị otu n'ime ndị bọọtụ ahụ nyere.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks na-apụ apụ enweghị ike iru adreesị dị na netwọkụ nke WeKan n'onwe ya, ka onye ọ bụla ghara ịtụgharị webhook nke bọọdụ gaa n'ọrụ dị n'ime. Depụta ebe a ndị ọbịa (host) dị na netwọkụ ahụ webhooks nwere ike iru - Node-RED, sava nkata - otu n'ahịrị ọ bụla, dị ka aha ma ọ bụ adreesị, ya na ọdụ ụgbọ (port) iji kwe naanị ọdụ ahụ. Efu: ọ dịghị nke ọ bụla. Naanị ndị nchịkwa saịtị nwere ike ịgbanwe ndepụta a.
account-webhook-desc: Otu adreesị WeKan na-agwa mgbe mmadụ banyere ma ọ bụ e mepụtara akaụntụ ọhụrụ. Ọ dịghị ihe a na-eziga ruo mgbe a kara akara n'ihe omume dị n'okpuru. Ọ na-ebu ihe omume ahụ, aha njirimara na oge; kaa akara n'ubi ndị ọzọ naanị ma ọ bụrụ na onye nnata chọrọ ha.
webhook-internal-hosts-rejected: Ọ bụghị onye ọbịa (host), echekwaghị ya:
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Kagbuo ọkwa niile na-eche maka ihe omume karịrị ụbọchị ole?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Akagbuola %s, eziga %s, %s ndị ochie ka na-eche.
vcs-synced-from: Emekọrịtara ya site na %s: mepee ma mechie ya n'ebe ahụ.
vcs-synced-issue: Emekọrịtara okwu a: mepee ma mechie ya n'ihe nleba anya ya.
sync-write-back: Dee mgbanwe azụ na GitLab: aha, nkọwa, okwu, imechi na imeghe ọzọ
email-bounces-description: Ihe WeKan na-eme ozi ịntanetị laghachiri: adreesị e dere ezighi ezi, igbe ozi juru eju, nzaghachi na-anọghị n'ọfịs, mkpesa spam. Ụdị ọ bụla nwere omume nke ya, a na-eme ha mgbe ọ laghachiri ugboro ahụ.
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Adreesị ahụ adịghị: njehie ide, akaụntụ ehichapụrụ, ngalaba amaghị ama.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Ebugaghị ya ugbu a: igbe ozi juru, sava na-arụsi ọrụ ike. Naanị ọtụtụ n'usoro pụtara ihe.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Nzaghachi nke na-anọghị n'ọfịs, ezumike ma ọ bụ sistemụ tiketi. Ebugara ozi ahụ.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Onye nnata kara ozi ahụ dịka spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Na Amazon SES, ziga ọkwa Bounce na Complaint, na iwu nnata maka adreesị WeKan si ezipụ, gaa n'isiokwu SNS, ma debanye adreesị a aha na ya site na HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN isiokwu SNS a ga-anabata, otu n'ahịrị ọ bụla
email-bounces-stopped-only: Naanị adreesị WeKan anaghịzi eziga ozi
email-bounces-clear-hint: Chefuo nlaghachi adreesị a ma zigakwa ya ozi ọzọ
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Nke ahụ abụghị ARN isiokwu SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Ọ bụrụ na WeKan na-ezipu site n'otu n'ime ọrụ ndị a, gbanye ya, nye ọrụ ahụ adreesị webhook a maka ihe omume ozi laghachiri na mkpesa spam ya, ma mado ebe a igodo ọ na-eji abịanye aka na ha, ma ọ bụ okwuntughe i tinyere n'adreesị dị ka https://user:password@… ma ọ bụ ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Ọrụ agbanyere chọrọ igodo mbinye aka ya ma ọ bụ okwuntughe ya.
activity-pub-enabled: Bọọdụ ọha na-ebipụta ọrụ kaadị ha na fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Agbanyụrụ ya na mbụ. Mgbe agbanyere ya, enwere ike ịgbaso bọọdụ ọha ọ bụla site na Mastodon na sava fediverse ndị ọzọ dị ka @board-<id> na adreesị WeKan a, ọrụ kaadị ọhụrụ na-erutekwa ndị na-eso ya. Ọ bụ naanị maka ịgụ: ọ dịghị ihe sava fediverse zitere na-agbanwe bọọdụ, a naghịkwa ebipụta bọọdụ nkeonwe ma ọlị.
caldav-sync-desc: Tinye ụbọchị ngwụcha kaadị bọọdụ a na kalenda - Nextcloud Calendar ma ọ bụ kalenda CalDAV ọ bụla. Ụbọchị ngwụcha a kwagara na kalenda na-alaghachi na kaadị ahụ. Jiri okwuntughe ngwa, ọ bụghị nke gị.
caldav-enabled: Dakọrịta ụbọchị ngwụcha na kalenda a
caldav-invalid-url: Adreesị kalenda ga-abụrịrị adreesị http:// ma ọ bụ https://, na-enweghị aha onye ọrụ ma ọ bụ okwuntughe n'ime ya.
caldav-not-linked: Buru ụzọ chekwaa adreesị kalenda ma gbanye ndakọrịta.
webdav-storage-description: Chekwaa mgbakwụnye n'ime folda na sava WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud ma ọ bụ nke ọzọ ọ bụla. Jiri okwuntughe ngwa e mere maka WeKan. Enwere ike iji sava dị na netwọk WeKan n'onwe ya ebe a, ebe ọ bụ naanị onye nchịkwa saịtị na-edozi adreesị a.
sqrl-desc: Agbanyụrụ ya na mbụ. Mgbe ọ na-agba, ibe mbanye na-enye SQRL, ndị otu na-ebu ụzọ tinye njirimara SQRL ha na Ntọala otu. SQRL chọrọ ka WeKan nọrọ na adreesị https://.
sqrl-scan: Jiri ngwa SQRL gị nyochaa koodu ahụ, ma ọ bụ mepee ngwa SQRL gị na ngwaọrụ a.
sqrl-expired: Koodu SQRL a agwụla oge. Malite ọzọ.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL chọrọ ka WeKan nọrọ na adreesị https://.
sqrl-description: Banye site na njirimara SQRL gị kama okwuntughe. Tinye ya ebe a otu ugboro site na ngwa SQRL gị; ị nwere ike iwepụ ya ebe a mgbe ọ bụla.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Ngwa SQRL gị emechiela mbanye site na SQRL maka akaụntụ a. Mepee ya ọzọ n'ebe ahụ site na koodu nnapụta gị.
sqrl-only-on: Ngwa SQRL gị ekpochiela akaụntụ a na SQRL: a jụrụ ụzọ ọ bụla ọzọ isi banye.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Ngwa SQRL gị ekpochiela akaụntụ a kpam kpam: a jụrụ ịtọgharị okwuntughe na ịgbanwe email.
sqrl-only: Akaụntụ a na-abanye naanị site na SQRL.
sqrl-hardlock: Akaụntụ a ka ekpochiri na SQRL: enweghị ike iweghachi ya ma ọ bụ gbanwee ya n'ụzọ ọ bụla ọzọ.
windows-sso-failed: Ịbanye site na Windows dara. Ọ nwere ike ịbụ na anaghị ekwe akaụntụ Windows gị ebe a.
enrollment-password-instructions: Kwenye okwuntughe gị ka ịmalite nhazi. Nzọụkwụ a agaghị eme ka ị banye. Ị pụghị ịgbanwe ebe a usoro nkwenye njirimara nke na-arụ ọrụ ugbua.
enrollment-setup-denied: Enweghị ike ịmalite nhazi. Lelee ozi nbanye gị ma chọpụta ma agbanyelarị koodu a na-eji otu ugboro.
enrollment-code-instructions: Jiri koodu dabere na oge: SHA1, ọnụọgụ isii na nkeji sekọnd 30 n’etiti koodu. Enyela onye ọ bụla igodo nzuzo ahụ. Nhazi a ga-agwụ mgbe nkeji ise gachara.
enrollment-confirmed-instructions: Ejirila koodu nkwenye ahụ. Tupu ịbanye, chere ka ngwa nkwenye njirimara gosi koodu ọhụrụ.
registration-first-admin: Akaụntụ mbụ na ngalaba a ga-enweta ikike onye nchịkwa zuru ụwa ọnụ.
auth-too-many-attempts: Agbalịala ịbanye ọtụtụ ugboro. Nwaa ọzọ ma emechaa.
registration-global-admin-disabled: A na-emepụta akaụntụ ndị nchịkwa zuru ụwa ọnụ n’ime sistemụ a. E mechiela ndebanye aha ọha.
registration-password-unavailable: Enweghị ike iji okwuntughe debanye aha.
expedite-limit: Naanị otu kaadị mepere emepe nke bọọdụ nwere ike ịbụ Ngwa ngwa n'otu oge.
list-policy-placeholder: Olee mgbe kaadị nwere ike ịbata na ndepụta a, oleekwa mgbe ọ gwụchara ebe a?
commitment-point-hint: A na-ekwe nkwa ọrụ site na ndepụta a gaa n'ihu; ndepụta ndị bu ya ụzọ bụ nhọrọ.
person-wip-limit: Oke WIP maka onye ọ bụla
person-wip-over: __user__ nwere kaadị __count__ ghe oghe; oke WIP maka onye ọ bụla bụ __limit__.
feature-list-policies-desc: Iwu nke ndepụta ọ bụla (mgbe kaadị nwere ike ịbata na mgbe ọ gwụchara n'ebe ahụ) n'isi ndepụta ahụ. A na-agbanye ya maka bọọdụ ọ bụla na Ntọala bọọdụ / Ndepụta.
feature-commitment-point-desc: Ndepụta e si na ya ekwe nkwa ọrụ, akara n'isi ya. A na-ahọrọ ya maka bọọdụ ọ bụla na Ntọala bọọdụ / Ndepụta.
feature-person-wip-limit: Oke WIP maka onye ọ bụla
feature-person-wip-limit-desc: Kaadị ole ghe oghe otu onye nwere ike ijide na bọọdụ; kaadị e meghere na-adọ aka ná ntị maka onye ọ bụla gafere ya. A na-esetịpụ ya maka bọọdụ ọ bụla na Ntọala bọọdụ / Ndepụta.
feature-standup-timer-desc: Nzukọ kwa ụbọchị dị na menu bọọdụ: ndị otu bọọdụ n'usoro agwakọtara agwakọta, onye ọ bụla nwere otu oke oge. A na-agbanyụ ya maka bọọdụ ọ bụla na Ntọala Scrum ya.
feature-retrospective-board-desc: Bọọdụ ntụgharị uche dị na menu bọọdụ: bọọdụ nkeonwe ọhụrụ nwere ndepụta Malite ime, Kwụsị ime, Gaa n'ihu ime na Ihe a ga-eme. A na-agbanyụ ya maka bọọdụ ọ bụla na Ntọala Scrum ya.
show-split-lists: Kwe ka e kewaa ndepụta n'ime Na-aga n'ihu na Emechaala
list-split: Kewaa n'ime Na-aga n'ihu na Emechaala
split-done: Emechaala ebe a, na-eche ka a dọkpụrụ ya n'ihu
mark-split-done: Kaa akara dị ka emechaala ebe a
feature-split-lists-desc: Ndepụta ekewara n'ime Na-aga n'ihu na Emechaala: kaadị a kara akara na emechaala ebe ahụ na-eche, nke na-adịghị ìhè nke ọma, ka a dọkpụrụ ya gaa na ndepụta na-esote, isi ndepụta ahụ na-agụkwa ha abụọ. A na-ekwe ya kwa bọọdụ na Ntọala bọọdụ / Ndepụta, wee gbanye ya na menu nke ndepụta ọ bụla.
workload-intro: Awa e mere atụmatụ na akara akụkọ nke kaadị e nyere onye ọ bụla, izu na izu, tụnyere awa ha nwere: oge ọrụ ha, oge ha anọghị na ezumike ọha. Pịa otu izu ka ịhụ kaadị ya.
workload-truncated: Ọ dị oke ukwuu igosi otu mgbe: akụkọ a na-egosi naanị ndị mbụ na kaadị mbụ. Họrọ izu ole na ole ma ọ bụ bọọdụ ole na ole.
workload-allocations-intro: Ole oge mmadụ na-aga na bọọdụ, ma ọ bụ ọrụ ndị bọọdụ ga-achọ tupu a họpụta onye ọ bụla.
feature-workload-desc: Ibu ọrụ na ikike n'ime menu onye ọrụ: awa e mere atụmatụ na akara akụkọ nke kaadị onye ọ bụla, izu na izu, tụnyere oge ọrụ ha, oge ha anọghị na ezumike ọha, ya na nkenye na bọọdụ na ọrụ nwa oge.
billing-intro: Bọọdụ ndị ị bụ onye nchịkwa ha: mmefu ego ha, ego ọrụ ha furu na nke ọ ga-efu dịka ọnụ ahịa kwa elekere ị setịrị, na akwụkwọ ụgwọ maka elekere ejirila rụọ ọrụ. Ọ bụ naanị ndị nchịkwa bọọdụ na-ahụ nke a.
billing-no-boards: Ị bụghị onye nchịkwa nke bọọdụ ọ bụla.

cloud-panel-settings-intro: Na Ngalaba Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin na-elekọta ngalaba ndị ahịa, ebe nchekwa data ha, DNS CloudFlare na ụzọ Caddy, onye ahịa ọ bụla na-ahụ akwụkwọ ụgwọ ya ma na-ekwurịta okwu na SuperAdmin. SuperAdmin bụ onye nchịkwa WeKan dịbu adị.
cloud-panel-cloudflare-target: Adreesị ngalaba ndị ahụ na-atụ aka na ya (adreesị IP ma ọ bụ aha onye nnabata)
cloud-panel-dns-conflict: __name__ enweelarị ndekọ __type__: a hapụrụ ya otú ọ dị.
cloud-panel-caddy-intro: Caddy na-eduga Ngalaba Cloud Panel na ngalaba ọ bụla a na-ekerịta n'ime WeKan a, na ngalaba ọ bụla nwere ebe nchekwa data nke ya n'ime igbe WeKan nke ya.
cloud-panel-caddy-upstream: WeKan a, otú Caddy si eru ya (host:port)
cloud-panel-caddy-pushed: Caddy nwere ụzọ ọhụrụ ndị ahụ.
cloud-panel-mode-own: WeKan nke ya na ebe nchekwa data
cloud-panel-database-uri: Eriri njikọ (ma ọ bụ akụkụ ndị dị n'okpuru)
cloud-panel-customers: Ndị ahịa na-abanye ebe a (aha njirimara ma ọ bụ adreesị ozi-e)
cloud-panel-domain-cloudflare: Debe ndekọ DNS ya na CloudFlare
cloud-panel-import-files: Mgbakwụnye __count__: depụtakwa faịlụ ndị ahụ site na nchekwa faịlụ nke WeKan ochie.
cloud-admin-not-allowed: Cloud Admin dị naanị na adreesị CLOUD environment variable nke sava kọwara, maka ndị Cloud Admin ya na maka ndị ahịa nke domain ndị o depụtara.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: Adreesị IPv4 na IPv6, na ọnụ ọgụgụ adreesị dị ka 203.0.113.0/24, nke Cloud Admin nwere ike ịbanye site na ha. Otu n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Efu: adreesị ọ bụla.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: Adreesị gị __address__ adịghị n'ndepụta a. Ịchekwa ya ga-akpọchi gị n'èzí, ya mere e chekwaghị ya.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: Adreesị IPv4 na IPv6 na usoro adreesị, otu n'ahịrị ọ bụla, ebe enwere ike iji Ogwe nchịkwa na admin REST API. Efu: adreesị ọ bụla.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: Mgbanwe gburugburu sava ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES na-ekpebi kama ndepụta a.
admin-panel-address-refused: Enweghị ike iji Ogwe nchịkwa site na adreesị gị __address__.
website-view-empty: Ọ dịbeghị ihe e bipụtara na saịtị weebụ a.
feature-views-website-desc: Bọọdụ dị ka saịtị weebụ: kaadị nke ndepụta Published ya, ụzọ Pages dị ka menu na kaadị ndị ọzọ dị ka edemede, nke kachasị ọhụrụ na mbụ, ya na mgbakwụnye ha. Bọọdụ ọha nwere ike imepe na nlele a, ka ndị ọbịa hụ saịtị weebụ ahụ na adreesị bọọdụ ahụ.
feature-views-shop-desc: Ngwaahịa dị na kaadị bọọdụ dị ka ụlọ ahịa weebụ: kaadị nwere ọnụahịa bụ ngwaahịa, aha ya bụ ụdị, ma ịtụ ihe bụ kaadị na ndepụta Ihe a tụrụ. Bọọdụ ọha nwere ike imepe na ya, ka ndị ọbịa zụọ ahịa n'adreesị bọọdụ ahụ.
shop-decrement-stock: Wepụ ngwaahịa a tụrụ n'ime ngwaahịa dị
shop-sale-lists: Ndepụta a na-ere (ọ dịghị nke akara: ndepụta niile ma e wezụga ndepụta Ihe a tụrụ)
shop-category-labels: Aha egosiri dị ka ụdị (ọ dịghị nke akara: aha niile)
shop-orders-private: A na-ede ihe a tụrụ na bọọdụ nzuzo, n'ihi na bọọdụ ọha na-egosi onye ọ bụla kaadị ọ bụla.
shop-guest-checkout: Ndị ọbịa na-enweghị akaụntụ nwere ike ịtụ
shop-show-on-public: Gosi ụlọ ahịa kama bọọdụ ọha
shop-show-on-public-note: Bọọdụ ọha na-emepe naanị n'otu nlele. Ịhọrọ ụlọ ahịa ebe a na-anọchi __view__ maka ndị ọbịa, ma ịhọrọ Saịtị weebụ ma ọ bụ nlele ọzọ na Ntọala bọọdụ / Nlele osisi na-anọchi ụlọ ahịa.
shop-empty: Enweghị ngwaahịa ka ugbu a. Kaadị nwere ọnụahịa na ndepụta a na-ere bụ ngwaahịa.
shop-privacy-note: A na-ede aha gị na nkọwa kọntaktị gị n'ihe a tụrụ ka ụlọ ahịa wee nyefee ya, ọ bụghịkwa ebe ọzọ.
shop-price-changed: Otu ọnụahịa agbanweela. Lelee ngụkọta ọhụrụ ma tụọ ọzọ.
shop-confirmation-email: Ziga onye na-azụ ihe nkwenye ihe ọ tụrụ site na ozi-e
import-board-instruction-wordpress: Na WordPress, họrọ Tools, Export, All content na Download Export File, ma họrọ faịlụ .xml ahụ ebe a ma ọ bụ mado ederede ya. Squarespace, Wix na saịtị ndị ọzọ na-ebupụ faịlụ WordPress na-arụ ọrụ otu ụzọ ahụ. Peeji na edemede ọ bụla na-aghọ kaadị na ndepụta ọnọdụ ya, peeji n'ụzọ Pages na edemede na Posts, ya na ọdịnaya ya, ụdị ya na tags ya dị ka aha, na okwu ya ndị a nabatara.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Chekwaa edemede na peeji nke REST API WordPress (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts na /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) dị ka otu faịlụ .json, ma họrọ ya ebe a ma ọ bụ mado ya. Peeji na edemede ọ bụla na-aghọ kaadị na ndepụta ọnọdụ ya.
import-board-instruction-ghost: Na Ghost, họrọ Settings, Labs, Export your content, ma họrọ faịlụ .json ebe a ma ọ bụ mado ya. Peeji na edemede ọ bụla na-aghọ kaadị na ndepụta ọnọdụ ya, ya na tags ya dị ka aha.
import-board-instruction-blogger: Na Blogger, họrọ Settings, Back up content, ma họrọ faịlụ .xml ebe a ma ọ bụ mado ederede ya. Edemede na peeji ọ bụla na-aghọ kaadị, ihe e dere n'ụzọ mbụ na ndepụta Draft, ya na aha ya na okwu ya.
